title: Delivery Head - Data Science
description:
About us:

Tredence is a global data science solutions provider focused on solving the last mile problem in AI. The ‘last mile’ is the gap between insight creation and value realization. Headquartered in San Jose, the company embraces a vertical-first approach and an outcome-driven mindset to help clients win and accelerate value realization from their analytics investments. Tredence is a Great Place to Work-Certified and a ‘Leader’ in the Forrester Wave: Customer Analytics Services. Tredence is close to 4000 employees strong, with the largest companies in retail, CPG, hi-tech, telecom, healthcare, travel and industrials as clients.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Data Science Delivery Leader to lead the end-to-end delivery of large, complex Data Science, Advanced Analytics, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI–driven programs across multiple business verticals. This role is part of Data Science Practice and works horizontally with vertical and functional teams to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery outcomes.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, strong program and project management skills, and proven experience managing large delivery teams and enterprise-scale programs. This is a pure delivery leadership role with no P&L, capability building, or practice management responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Delivery & Technical Oversight

• Own and drive end-to-end delivery of large-scale, multi-year Data Science, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI programs, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, quality, and cost.

• Provide strong technical oversight across solution design, ML/AI model development, GenAI solution architecture (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning), agent workflows, validation, deployment, and productionization.

• Ensure delivery aligns with agreed enterprise architectures, data standards, security, Responsible AI, and governance requirements.

• Act as the senior escalation point for critical technical, architectural, and delivery issues, including GenAI and AI-agent related risks.

2. Program & Project Management

• Lead multiple concurrent programs and projects using Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery models, including complex AI and GenAI engagements.

• Establish and run delivery governance, cadence reviews, and executive-level status reporting for AI and GenAI initiatives.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate delivery risks and dependencies proactively, including model performance, scalability, ethical AI, and regulatory risks.

• Ensure effective coordination across cross-functional teams, platform teams, vendors, and stakeholders.

3. Team Leadership (Delivery-Focused)

• Lead and manage delivery teams of data scientists, ML engineers, GenAI engineers, data engineers, and analysts to ensure execution excellence.

• Set clear delivery goals, roles, and accountability for large, distributed program teams.

• Drive performance management, resource planning, and delivery productivity across traditional AI and GenAI/Agentic AI workloads.

4. Stakeholder Management

• Partner closely with business and vertical leaders to translate business requirements into scalable AI, GenAI, and agent-based delivery plans.

• Communicate program progress, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior leadership and client stakeholders, including AI-specific metrics and value realization.

• Ensure high levels of stakeholder satisfaction through predictable, transparent, and outcome-driven delivery.

5. Delivery Excellence

• Ensure consistent application of AI/ML and GenAI delivery best practices, tools, and quality benchmarks.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes to enhance efficiency, reliability, and reusability of AI and GenAI solutions.

• Support presales and transition activities through delivery planning, solution estimates, execution readiness, and risk assessments (as required).

**Required Qualifications**

• 17+ years of overall experience, with 8–10+ years in Data Science / Advanced Analytics / AI delivery roles.

• Strong hands-on technical foundation in Machine Learning, AI, Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning), and Agentic AI concepts, with the ability to guide teams in depth.

• Proven experience managing large programs, multi-project portfolios, and complex AI/GenAI delivery engagements.

• Solid expertise in program and project management methodologies and delivery governance models.

• Experience with tools and technologies such as Python, R, ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) and exposure to LLM ecosystems.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

• Experience delivering AI, GenAI, and agent-based solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Exposure to LLM platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI pipelines.

• Exposure to big data ecosystems (Spark, Hadoop, Hive).

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
  
  
Cognite operates at the forefront of
**industrial digitalization, building AI**
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
  
  
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Data Scientist at Cognite, you will work on challenging data problems with leaders in the industry. You will be a part of cross-functional teams that include data engineers, solution architects, and project managers. Together, your focus will be on configuring, deploying, and operationalising digital solutions in sectors such as Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, and Manufacturing.
  
  
Additionally, you will engage with clients to understand their desired outcomes, lead discovery workshops, and provide insights on potential strategies and obstacles. The data science team is a part of the MENA delivery team in our global delivery organisation. We are a good mix of project managers, data scientists, data engineers and solution architects with domain expertise from oil and gas, power & utilities and manufacturing.
  
  
We are responsible for delivering successful projects that are flexible and scalable and foster adoption of our product. In sum, we derive valuable insights from previously hidden data, enabling workers and leaders to transform how heavy asset industries operate to become more efficient and sustainable.
  
  
The Impact you bring to Cognite
  
  
**A typical day as a Cogniter will contain the following tasks & responsibilities:**

* Develop and deploy scalable solutions for customer use cases from Oil and Gas, Manufacturing and Power & Utilities industries using Cognite’s core capabilities
* Participate in and contribute to intensive use case generation workshops with subject matter experts to understand the problem and how it maps to the data
* Perform data cleansing, exploratory data analysis and data modelling.
* Implement physical models / machine learning models in Python and deploy to our model hosting environment
* Work on an agentic AI solution to solve customers' use cases.
* Utilize and contribute to solution templates and best practices within the Data Science team
* Collaborate with data engineers, project managers and solution architects on project deliveries to enable our customers to achieve the full potential of our industrial dataops platform
* Support customers and partners in conducting data science tasks with Cognite products

**We Believe Most Of These Should Match Your Experience**

* Bachelor of Technology/Engineering or Master of Science in a quantitative field or mechanical, computer science, electrical or similar.
* 6- 10 years of work experience as a data scientist (preferably within related industry) or data scientist with domain expertise in Oil and Gas or Maintenance
* Proficient experience with Python and SQL. Experience with Python in a production setting is a plus
* Experience with machine learning methods and techniques, statistics and/or optimisation
* Must have experience with Agentic AI solutions.
* Experience with GIT
* Experience working customer-facing with external customers
* Experience with managed cloud services such as GCP, Azure or AWS is a plus
* Domain knowledge or a good understanding of the Oil and Gas industry is a plus.
* Enjoy working in cross-functional teams
* Able to deliver independently, coach and mentor others internally
* Enjoy challenges and dare to set ambitious goals that drive innovation
* Humility to ask for help and enjoy sharing knowledge with others

**Learn More About Us**

* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

title: IBP Supply Planning Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description**
**Integrated Business Planning (IBP)**
brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process. This integration ensures alignment across the enterprise, leading to superior customer outcomes.
  
  
Agilent is building our enterprise planning capabilities to drive IBP across the business by establishing Global Demand & Supply Planning Teams, and a centralized Planning Excellence Team (PET). Collectively, this new structure will continue to lead our Ignite IBP transformation journey which will strengthen our competitive advantage by enabling faster, more reliable planning. The IBP Supply Planning Data Scientist role will bring key data scientist capabilities to this effort.
  
  
As the
**IBP Supply Planning Data Scientist**
, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining advanced inventory and supply planning models, refreshing portfolio inventory targets, and monitoring key planning parameters to ensure the business is positioned to meet demand reliably and efficiently.
  
  
**Principle Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Provide data-driven insights, dashboards, and scenario modeling to support supply planners, S&OE/S&OP processes, and enterprise decision-making
* Drive continuous improvement in supply and inventory analytics, data quality, and model reliability
* Drive automation and advanced analytics, leveraging Python, SQL, and BI tools to scale insights
* Partner with Supply Planning Stewards to align analytics with standards, governance, and process maturity efforts
* Build, maintain, and enhance inventory optimization models (safety stock, segmentation, variability-based rules, reorder logic)
* Refresh inventory targets across the portfolio and ensure alignment with service expectations, demand patterns, and supply constraints
* Monitor and tune critical inventory parameters (lead times, variability, cycle stock inputs, yield factors) based on actual system performance
* Analyze inventory health (target adherence, shortages, excess, age, replenishment performance) and provide insights to planners and leaders
* Provide inventory-focused scenario analysis for demand changes, supply disruptions, or service-level shifts
* Support supply planners with modeling supply capability (RCCP, constraints, capacity modeling, yield/throughput assumptions)
* Generate dashboards and KPIs that reflect supply plan stability, attainment, constraint exposure, and readiness
* Enable S&OE/S&OP with near-term supply-demand coverage analytics, including early warning indicators
* Develop and maintain supply-focused models (scenario models, coverage calculators, constraint dashboards) for decision support

title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description:

This Position reports to:
  
  
Senior Operation Manager for D&A
  
  
  
  
  
**Mission of the Role**
Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a
**hands-on AI/ML Engineer**
to join our
**Information Systems (IS)**
.
  
  
This is a
**specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**
. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.
  
  
If you have experience with
**Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**
, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!
  
  
**Work model:**
Hybrid
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from Snowflake and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, cost monitoring, root-cause analysis, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**
**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical Skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake AI/ML tools (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating SAP and Salesforce data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.

**What We Offer**

title: Data Scientist
description:

Bangalore, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Experience: 5 to 10 years

Full-Time
  
  
**Job Description:**
Supply Chain Intelligence is seeking an experienced
**Data Scientist**
to build customer-facing insights from idea to production. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who can move fluently across product discovery, data engineering, statistical analysis, machine learning, data modeling, and software delivery. You will work directly with product, engineering, domain experts, and customers to turn complex data into useful experiences: discovering insights, identifying statistically meaningful and mathematically exploitable patterns, validating them rigorously, and shipping them as reliable product capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own data-driven product capabilities end to end — from product hypothesis and data discovery through modeling, implementation, production deployment, measurement, and iteration.
* Explore complex data sets to find meaningful structure, latent relationships, anomalies, predictive signals, and mathematically exploitable patterns that can create customer value.
* Design and build data pipelines and analytical data models that make raw, messy, high-volume data usable for experimentation, machine learning, analytics, and customer-facing features.
* Develop statistical and machine-learning solutions including classification, ranking, forecasting, recommendation, anomaly detection, optimization, clustering, and other techniques appropriate to the problem.
* Translate models into product experiences by partnering with software engineers and product designers on APIs, services, workflows, visualizations, recommendations, and decision-support features.
* Define rigorous evaluation methods using offline metrics, experiments, benchmarks, error analysis, confidence estimates, and production telemetry to prove that a capability works and continues to work.
* Work directly with domain experts and customers to understand real decision-making problems, refine hypotheses, validate outputs, and distinguish statistically interesting findings from genuinely useful product insight.
* Productionize and operate data science systems with attention to latency, scalability, observability, reproducibility, cost, data quality, model drift, and graceful handling of uncertainty.
* Communicate clearly across disciplines explaining assumptions, evidence, trade-offs, limitations, and results to product, engineering, business, and technical stakeholders without unnecessary jargon.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, quantitative product development, data engineering, or closely related work.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with deep hands-on experience using Jupyter notebooks and modern data science libraries for exploration, experimentation, modeling, evaluation, and communicating results.
* Strong foundation in statistics and applied mathematics including probability, experimental design, hypothesis testing, regression, uncertainty, sampling, optimization, and model evaluation.
* Hands-on machine learning experience with common supervised and unsupervised methods and a strong understanding of feature engineering, leakage, overfitting, calibration, bias, and generalization.
* Strong working knowledge of databases and data platforms, including relational databases, SQL, analytical warehouses/lakehouses, data transformation, schema design, data quality, and working efficiently with large data sets.
* Strong data modeling skills across analytical and operational use cases, including relational, dimensional, document, and feature-oriented representations where appropriate.
* Experience delivering customer-facing products where models, algorithms, or data-derived insights are part of a real application, workflow, API, or interactive experience.
* Experience working with modern data and ML platforms such as Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, or equivalent tooling, and with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
* Understanding of the full ML lifecycle, including reproducible experimentation, feature development, experiment tracking, model/version management, evaluation, batch and online inference, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies.
* Ability to frame ambiguous problems quantitatively, define measurable outcomes, choose an appropriate analytical approach, and know when a simpler statistical or deterministic method is better than ML.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with product managers, software engineers, data engineers, designers, domain experts, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven track record of delivering machine-learning solutions into production and demonstrating measurable customer or business impact.
* Breadth across multiple ML problem families, such as classification and regression, ranking and recommendation, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting and time-series modeling, optimization, and probabilistic or statistical inference.
* Experience working across data modalities including structured/tabular data, text and NLP, images/computer vision, embeddings, and multimodal systems that combine text, image, and structured data.

We enable your best to power our future.**
**Job Description**
At Nielsen, we are seeking a Data Scientist to join our team. Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries with the latest advancements in AI/ML? Does the prospect of applying Cutting-edge AI research to develop industry-defining software solutions for audience measurement excite you?
  
  
In this role, you will be at the forefront of our mission, leveraging sophisticated machine learning and AI to deliver a comprehensive understanding of audience behavior. You will architect and implement AI/ML systems that unlock novel insights from complex audience data.
  
  
Skills: Strong understanding and experience in Statistical Modelling and techniques.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to work with high motivation and agility in a dynamic environment.
  
  
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Python (Expert): Strong proficiency in Python with extensive experience in libraries such as: Scikit-learn, Pandas & NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, SciPy.
  
  
Statistical Modeling: Strong grasp of statistical concepts including hypothesis testing, probability distributions, regression analysis, and inferential statistics.
  
  
Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering: Proven ability to handle missing data, outliers, categorical variables, scaling, normalization, and create impactful features from raw data.
  
  
Proficiency in unsupervised learning techniques (e.g., K -Means, hierarchical clustering, PCA).
  
  
Knowledge of ensemble methods and their practical application.
  
  
SQL: Solid proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis from relational databases.
  
  
Classical Machine Learning: Thorough understanding of supervised learning (e.g., Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting Machines like XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost, SVMs, Naive Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbors).
  
  
Model Evaluation & Validation: Hands-on experience with cross-validation, regularization techniques, hyperparameter tuning (e.g., GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV), and understanding of various evaluation metrics for classification and regression.
  
  
Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  
  

* Programming Languages: Python

Problem -Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable components.
  
  
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical concepts and insights effectively.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Responsibilities:**
Model Development: Lead the development and implementation of data science solutions. Design, develop, train, and validate classical machine learning models (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering, Tree-based models like Random Forests, Gradient Boosting Machines, SVMs, etc.) to solve specific business problems.
  
  
Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering: Perform extensive data cleaning, transformation, and feature engineering to prepare diverse datasets for model training. Identify and create relevant features to improve model performance.
  
  
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Conduct thorough EDA to understand data characteristics, identify patterns, anomalies, and relationships, and inform model selection and development.
  
  
Model Evaluation & Optimization: Implement rigorous model evaluation techniques (e.g., cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning) and metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, RMSE, MAE) to assess model performance and optimize models for production.
  
  
Production Deployment (MLOps Fundamentals): Collaborate with MLOps/DevOps teams to integrate, deploy, and monitor classical ML models in production environments. Understand basic concepts of model serving and API development.
  
  
Algorithm Selection & Customization: Research and select appropriate classical ML algorithms based on problem type, data characteristics, and performance requirements.
  
  
Deep Learning and Neural Networks: Move beyond traditional ML algorithms to understand and implement deep learning architectures (CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers) for tasks like image recognition, natural language processing, and sequence modeling.
  
  
Documentation & Communication: Document models, methodologies, and results clearly and concisely. Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Research & Innovation: Stay updated with the latest advancements in classical machine learning, statistical modeling, and data science best practices. Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  
  
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and deliver impactful results. Work closely with data scientists, data engineers, product managers, and business analysts to define problems, gather requirements, and deliver impactful ML solutions.
  
  
Required Qualifications: Bachelors of Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science,Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
5 to 9 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying AI/ML models.
  
  
Proficiency in Python Demonstrable experience with Multi Modal Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application.
  
  
Experience with developing simple UIs for model interaction or data annotation (e.g., using Streamlit, Gradio, Flask/Django). Good understanding of MLOps principles and experience with tools for model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, MLflow).
  
  
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code versioning (Git), testing, and CI/CD practices.
  
  
Excellent problem -solving skills and the ability to work with complex, large-scale datasets.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Full Stack Development experience in any one stack
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Preferred Qualifications / Bonus Skills:**
Experience with Generative AI models.
  
  
Track record of publications in top -tier AI/ML/CV conferences or journals.
  
  
Experience working with sports data (broadcast feeds, social media imagery, sponsorship analytics).
  
  
Proficiency in cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their AI/ML services.
  
  
Experience with video processing and analysis techniques.
  
  
Familiarity with data pipeline and distributed computing tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka).
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and mentor team members.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**TITLE:**
Senior Data Scientist

**DEPARTMENT:**
Data Sciences & Analytics

**Team:**

Data Sciences & Analytics is a global CoE team, incubated within Victoria’ Secret & Co. (VS&Co), building the best-in-class suite of Data Science & Analytics Products that power the best shopping experience for our customers, and deliver actionable, customer-centric insights to our ecommerce, marketing, merchandising and supply chain teams enabling better business decisions on omni channel (digital + store) 360 performances.

**Purpose:**

The Senior data scientist will play a large technical role in architecting data science solutions working with team members & business stakeholders to deliver outstanding business outcomes for problems across VS&Co:

* You will be leading the build of machine learning models on:

1. customer segmentations, lookalike, affinity, CLV & propensity models,

1. Agentic AI & GenAI Conversational Bots,

1. Price elasticity, offer personalization & promo optimization models,
2. Recommendation & personalization systems,
3. Forecasting & optimization systems.

* You have a deep interest and passion for technology. You love writing and owning codes and enjoy working with people who will keep challenging you at every stage. You have strong problem solving, analytic, decision-making, and excellent communication with interpersonal skills. You are self-driven and motivated with the desire to work in a fast-paced, results-driven agile environment with varied responsibilities.

* You will work directly on the AI problems that have the most impact on VS&Co's digital e-commerce, customer/marketing, pricing/promotions, forecasting/optimizations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Deliver data science CoE projects from India; Engage & collaborate with business & technology partners. Communicate progress to all stakeholders.

* Design the development of solutions that leverage data sciences & advanced analytics to develop required business solutions.

* Perform deep exploratory analysis on large scale customer data, identify shopping & interaction patterns, discover price elasticity & price sensitivity behaviors and build lifecycle models for targeting customers towards loyalty.
* Build conversational agents to deliver faster insights that drive customer strategy on acquisition, retention & growth.

* Evaluate, recommend, & implement state-of-the art algorithms and methods.

* Knowledge of MLOps practices.

* Mentor junior members of the team and help drive technical rigor on all aspects of data science & ML solutioning.

**Education:**

* B.S. degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics

* M.S. or PH.D. in Computer Science, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, operations research, quantitative social sciences or related fields will be preferred.

* 4+ years after Bachelors of relevant experience in data scientist & analytics role preferably in retail domain.
* Strong programming skills. Expert level proficiency in Python, SQL.

* Strong written & verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate complicated statistical analytical concepts & solutions to business stakeholders in a simplified comprehensible manner.

* Excellent presentation skills & ability to shape course of action through persuasion & negotiations.

* Collaborate actively with topic owners to understand and develop advanced analytics / data science

* Experience designing algorithms for a relevance system such as a personalized tool, search/ranking, recommendations, forecasting, marketing, loyalty, etc.
* Strong engineering mindset and exposure to software engineering principles, Agile methodologies, distributed systems and applied Machine Learning.

* Experience building Agentic AI systems and hands-on exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation frameworks and end-to-end Agentic AI production expertise.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Machine Learning, Python, Big Data Skills, R, Statistics

* Solid experience working with state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms on real-world problems, preferably in ecommerce and retail domains.

* Strong ability to understand the business and good stakeholder management capabilities and has mentored data scientists in developing ML solutions.

* Experience playing the role of full-stack data scientist and taking solutions to production.

description:
**Job Summary:**

This initiative aims to achieve quantifiable improvements in user engagement, satisfaction, and retention, driven by data-driven innovations.

**About the team:**

We’re an agile, fast-moving team, focused on turning bold ideas into impactful products. From rapid prototyping of new concepts to building scalable platforms that power future growth, we thrive on experimentation and innovation.

Our platform highlights creators and their narratives by giving them AI-powered systems using advanced machine learning and multimedia pipelines.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Design, prototype, and refine deep learning models for text-to-video and image-to-video generation using cutting-edge techniques in generative AI (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, temporal GANs)
* Collaborate with 3rd-party AI vendors to evaluate their capabilities, run quality benchmarks, and drive technical integration where applicable
* Lead the creation of in-house solutions to augment 3rd-party offerings, with a focus on improving video quality, generation time, and content relevance
* Develop robust pipelines for dataset curation, preprocessing, training, and model evaluation, including automated visual, temporal, and semantic quality metrics
* Work closely with product managers, engineering teams, and senior leadership to define use cases, set priorities, and bring production-grade AI systems to life
* Run A/B tests, iterate based on performance feedback, and ensure alignment with product experience goals and creative quality standards
* Stay ahead of the curve in the fast-moving GenAI space; guide strategy, share insights internally, and represent the team in technical forums as needed

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Strong understanding of LLMs, with hands-on experience in fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and evaluating foundation models for applied use-cases for multimodal generation
* Proven experience with deep learning architectures for generative tasks (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, GANs)
* Solid understanding of computer vision, natural language processing, and multimodal learning
* Experience with training large-scale models, transfer learning, and fine-tuning on custom datasets
* Familiarity with ML evaluation techniques, including perceptual quality metrics and user-in-the-loop testing
* Knowledge of model deployment and performance tuning in production environments
* Hands-on experience building and optimizing text-to-video, image-to-video, or similar generative pipelines
* Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and TensorFlow/PyTorch for implementing and evaluating algorithms
* Excellent communication skills; able to present complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with experimental design and A/B testing methodologies
* Strong leadership capabilities with demonstrated experience mentoring junior data scientists

**Preferred education and experience:**

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative field with 2-4 years of experience in data science/machine learning

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. description:
**Location:**
Delhi / Bangalore

**Work Model:**
Hybrid — 3 days in office

**About Elucidata**

Elucidata is an AI Solutions Tech Data-centric AI company on a mission to make life sciences AI-ready. Headquartered in San Francisco with a 120+ member team across the US and India, we’re building the future of data-centric AI for drug discovery.

Our flagship AI-Agentic powered platform, Polly, helps research teams wrangle, harmonize, and analyze massive volumes of biomedical data, accelerating discoveries and making precision medicine a reality.

Recognized by Fast Company as the “Most Innovative Biotech Company of 2024,” Elucidata partners with 25+ leading organizations, including Pfizer, Novo Nordisk, Google DeepMind, Alnylam Therapeutics, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Research Institute. Backed by top VCs like Eight Roads, F-Prime, IvyCap, and Hyperplane.

With over 200 data products and AI solutions co-developed by 100+ domain experts, we’ve helped our partners achieve 4X faster R&D milestones and contribute to 16 therapies advancing toward FDA approval. At Elucidata, you’ll work at the intersection of AI, biology and impact while solving real-world challenges that accelerate the journey from data to discovery.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior ML Scientist to drive research and development at the intersection of AI and biology, with a focus on solving complex problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

In this role, you will own the development, training, and evaluation of advanced ML models, including LLMs, deep learning models, and biological foundation models, working with diverse data sources such as scientific literature, clinical data, and multi-omics datasets.

You will collaborate closely with computational biologists, ML engineers, and product teams to translate scientific challenges into innovative, practical AI solutions, while driving rigorous experimentation, scientific validation, and research outcomes.

**What You’ll Own**

* Lead research and development initiatives at the intersection of AI and biology, translating complex scientific problems into well-defined ML problems and actionable solutions.
* Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate ML models, including LLMs, transformer-based models, and biological foundation models, for applications in drug discovery and biomedical research.
* Build AI-driven solutions for extracting and synthesizing biological knowledge from scientific literature, clinical data, and other biomedical sources.
* Explore and develop novel approaches for analyzing complex biological datasets, including single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, and multi-omics data.
* Design rigorous experiments, establish evaluation benchmarks, and ensure scientific validity, reproducibility, and robustness of model outputs.
* Own research projects end-to-end, from literature reviews and hypothesis formulation to experimentation, validation, and communicating findings through technical reports, publications, or product capabilities.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* PhD from a tier-1 institution in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related discipline; alternatively, a Master’s degree with 3–4 years of relevant industry experience applying AI/ML to biological problems.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, or related areas, with the ability to interpret biological data and reason about underlying biological mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing and training ML/deep learning models, preferably applied to biomedical NLP, genomics, multi-omics, or drug discovery.
* Excellent Python programming skills, with practical experience in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and modern data science and ML libraries.
* Strong scientific research skills, including reading and critically evaluating research papers, designing experiments, benchmarking methods, and drawing evidence-based conclusions.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, tackle ambiguous research problems, challenge assumptions, and translate research findings into practical, high-impact solutions.

**Why Join Elucidata?**

* Opportunity to shape the future of biomedical data ecosystems by building partnerships at the frontier of science and healthcare.
* Direct visibility with the CEO and leadership team.
* High-impact role — the partnerships you establish will directly translate into Elucidata’s growth and customer success.
* Work with global leaders and contribute to data-driven drug discovery.

title: Advisor/Senior Advisor – Process Engineering and Modeling
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Advisor/Senior Advisor – Process Engineering and Modeling, Chromatography & Process Systems (R5)**
**Organization Overview**
Lilly unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly has a nearly 150-year heritage of scientific innovation, excellence, integrity, and respect for people.
  
  
The Product Research and Development (PRD) organization develops and delivers quality medicines to patients by advancing Lilly’s portfolio across small molecules, synthetic peptides, insulins, monoclonal antibodies, novel therapeutic proteins, oligonucleotide therapies, and gene therapy systems. PRD is a multidisciplinary organization that collaborates across therapeutic business units and manufacturing to deliver clinical and commercial medicines globally.
  
  
Lilly-Bengaluru, India is a strategic investment to attract top scientific and technical talent from India’s vibrant academic and professional environment. The PRD team in Bengaluru works closely with PRD colleagues in Indianapolis and across the global organization to enable delivery of Lilly’s portfolio.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Advisor – Process Engineering and Modeling will provide technical leadership in modeling, simulation, data science, and process engineering to support small molecule and synthetic peptide drug substance development. The role applies deep scientific, engineering, mathematical, and computational expertise to solve problems in chromatography purification, reaction systems, and other unit operations at both small and large scale.
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical depth, broad modeling capability, scientific leadership, and a collaborative approach to solving complex process development and manufacturing challenges.
  
  

* Develop and apply customized computer models, computational tools, and commercial modeling software to support process understanding and decision-making.
* Use modeling and simulation to inform process development, scale-up, technology transfer, manufacturing, and validation.
* Apply artificial intelligence and machine learning methods to solve process engineering problems and extract insight from complex data sets.
* Contribute to research projects and programs focused on development of small molecule and synthetic peptide active pharmaceutical ingredients for clinical and commercial use.
* Design data-rich experiments using automated laboratory reactors, process analytical technology probes, and appropriate kinetic, thermodynamic, and transport measurements to support impurity control and manufacturing scale-up.
* Improve research and development effectiveness through computer modeling, simulation, optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead modeling activities for small molecule and synthetic peptide drug substance development, including mechanistic modeling, data-driven modeling, simulation, and optimization.
* Design and develop model-derived solutions to support clinical and commercial manufacturing processes, including batch and continuous processes, material supply, registration-enabling process understanding, and robust control strategies.
* Identify and communicate process risks, design opportunities, and modeling-based recommendations to project teams and management to enable sound technical and business decisions.
* Use internal and external modeling and experimental resources to mitigate technical risks before they affect project delivery timelines.
* Partner with product teams to provide technical oversight for process scale-up and technology transfer to internal manufacturing sites and external CDMOs.
* Collaborate across PRD to identify decisions that can be informed by data science, statistical modeling, machine learning, and process engineering analysis.
* Select and apply fit-for-purpose data science tools and methodologies to influence development decisions.
* Develop tools and algorithms to mine patterns in existing data and generate recommendations for future experiments, process questions, and modeling strategies.
* Communicate model assumptions, limitations, results, and recommendations clearly to scientific, engineering, manufacturing, and leadership stakeholders.
* Mentor and influence project teams by promoting model-informed development, scientific rigor, and an Agile mindset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 0–5 years of industry experience in modeling, simulation, process engineering, or data science applied to pharmaceutical process development.
* Substantial computer modeling expertise, including application and/or development of modeling tools for process engineering problems.
* Demonstrated experience with process development, scale-up, and technology transfer to internal manufacturing sites or external CDMOs.
* Strong foundation in mathematical analysis, advanced mathematics, and applied problem solving for science- and engineering-based systems.
* Proficiency with mathematical analysis and process modeling programs such as JMP, MATLAB, ASPEN, Dynochem, or gPROMS.
* Experience programming in scripting languages such as R or Python.
* Experience using statistical or machine learning tools, with the ability to implement custom algorithms as needed.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions, influence technical decisions, and drive solutions with an Agile mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience applying optimization, computational fluid dynamics, and computational chemistry tools to solve process engineering problems.
* Experience with chromatography purification experimentation and modelling.
* Experience designing data-rich experiments using automated lab reactors and process analytical technology probes.
* Experience translating kinetic, thermodynamic, and transport data into process understanding, impurity control strategies, and scale-up recommendations.
* Successful interaction with senior engineering and scientific personnel across matrixed project teams.

**Additional Information**

* Limited international travel, approximately 2–4%, may be required.
* Work-hour flexibility is required to support collaboration across multiple time zones.

description:

**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!
  
  
Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
* Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
* New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
* Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
* Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
* Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
* US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
* Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

**Why AstraZeneca**
Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. title: Senior Growth Analyst
description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. As well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.
  
  
**Join the team!**
Kwalee’s Growth Analytics team is looking for a Senior Growth Analyst to be the early-warning radar and the money brain of our mobile portfolio. Whenever the data hints at a problem or an opportunity, you’ll help us see it, size it, and act on it fast.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Be our early-warning radar. Build smart, automated monitoring across revenue, spend, ROAS, and retention so the right people know what’s changing, quickly.
* Build the money models. Create and improve the LTV and ROAS models that guide our UA targets.
* Guide where the money goes. Help UA find where the next pound of spend works hardest across games and channels.
* Detect, diagnose, recommend. When something moves, find out why, put a number on it, and bring clear options.
* Prove what works. Help the whole team measure the real impact of their work, so we learn from every win.
* Level up creative testing. Help design how we test and pick winning ads, and the dashboards that track them.

**Portfolio insight and commercial modelling.**

* How early we spot changes, and how useful the alerts are.
* Accuracy of LTV forecasts.
* Value of the recommendations the team acts on.
* How clearly we can see the impact of our work.

**Essential**

* Several years of analytics experience in mobile games or another app business with paid acquisition.

* Hands-on experience with LTV prediction, cohort analysis, and ROAS modelling.
* A solid grasp of experiment design and statistics.
* Commercial instinct: you talk in outcomes and recommend actions.
* A clear communicator who makes data easy for everyone.

**Desirable**

* Experience building automated monitoring or anomaly detection is a big plus.
* Familiarity with mobile attribution and ad data.

**Why Kwalee?**

* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!

The successful candidate will join the Talent Insights and Analytics Team (TIA), a key sub function, who enables transformation by providing global, reliable, and integrated talent data solutions that help leaders make smarter, data-driven talent decisions.
  
  
The TIA Advanced Analytics Sub-Pillar team is expanding their Talent Intelligence capabilities to complement our existing data models and solutions.
  
  
Our mission is to leverage Talent Intelligence to support business decisions by combining and analyzing various sources of information about the external talent landscape. We provide Talent Intelligence solutions, analysis, and recommendations to EY business and talent leaders across all service lines and geographies, addressing challenges questions throughout the talent lifecycle.
  
  
Through our dedicated Global Talent Intelligence platform, we have access to millions of data points, including over 20 million mapped companies, 1.1 billion profiles, and data from 5,200 cities, all aligned to a central skills taxonomy of 3,400 skills and activities.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Talent Intelligence Analyst to join our global Talent Insights and Analytics team. This role will focus on talent and workforce external labor data, transforming data from external vendors, and producing actionable insights that resonate with stakeholders. The successful candidate will also be responsible for building Talent Intelligence solutions in PowerBI and integrating Talent Intelligence data into our existing suite of solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with the Global Talent Intelligence Behavioral Science Lead and other team members to provide actionable insights and recommendations that drive strategic workforce decisions. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to the advancement of Talent Intelligence at EY.
  
  
**About You**
You are a detail-oriented and analytical professional with a strong background in data transformation, statistical analysis, and data visualization. You have a strong foundational understanding of labor market dynamics, and behavioral science and are eager to apply your skills to support Talent Intelligence initiatives. You thrive in a global and collaborative environment and are excited about the opportunity to work with a diverse team of experts to drive EY's talent strategy forward.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Understand and transform data from external vendors to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Assess the effectiveness of data sources and data-gathering techniques and aid continuous improvement and enhancement of the overarching Talent Intelligence analytics suite development.
* Utilize programming languages such as R or Python to analyze and interpret data.
* Effectively leverage SQL to manipulate Talent Intelligence data.
* Create and maintain PowerBI dashboards to visualize data and communicate insights effectively.
* Conduct applied talent research and productize insights at scale, using both internal and external economic and talent data to build insights and recommendations.
* Collaborate with the Global Talent Intelligence Behavioral Science Lead and other team members to understand business needs and provide tailored Talent Intelligence solutions.
* Assist in the development and delivery of Talent Intelligence products, reports, and presentations.
* Monitor external best practices and internal feedback to identify and propose opportunities and support the functional leads in the feasibility analysis for the enhancement of existing practices, models, and processes.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning and development within the TIA team.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Behavioural Science, Psychology, or a related field.
* Deep subject matter expertise in data engineering, visualization, and related functional domains to generate and support insights and analytics.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as R and statistical software like SPSS.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as PowerBI.
* Foundational understanding of behavioural science principles and their application to Talent Intelligence.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, with a passion for leveraging data to drive strategic business decisions.

**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
Arrive is seeking a Senior Data Scientist with a strong technical background to join our growing Data Science team in the AI & Analytics Experience. The purpose of this role is to deliver data science products and impactful solutions across the organization, playing a key role in advancing Arrive's data capabilities and ensuring data insights are effectively integrated into decision-making. This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage a modern data stack (including AWS, Snowflake, and DBT) and empower teams with self-service analytics (through Looker and Streamlit).
  
  
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will occupy a key senior individual contributor position, leading high-impact projects, mentoring other data scientists, and guiding technical architecture. Reporting to the Manager of Data Science within the DNA function, you will partner closely with key senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Distribution. You will have a broad scope to have an impact by supporting sales via lead optimization, identifying fraudulent accounts, creating advanced parking insights (occupancy prediction, free-to-pay simulator, enforcement coverage, etc.), and providing tools and insights to guide the organization's next best actions.
  
  
**How To Make An Impact**

* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of ML projects — from problem framing, data exploration, feature engineering, and model development to deployment and monitoring.
* Partner with cross-functional leadership on joint strategic initiatives to deliver measurable business impact.
* Identify, address, and resolve architectural and technical hurdles in developing scalable data science solutions.
* Drive architectural decisions regarding pipelines, model registries, or feature store development ensuring scalability, cost efficiency and reliability.
* Raise the technical bar of the team by actively mentoring other data scientists and promoting engineering best practices.
* Stay curious by exploring and implementing cutting-edge data science technologies to foster continuous team innovation.
* Translate complex data insights into practical business strategies and lead technical discussions with senior stakeholders.
* Mentoring junior data scientists and partnering with other DNA leads to nurture a data-driven culture and improve data literacy throughout Arrive.
* Design and prototype Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT)

**About You**
You are an expert, collaborative, and strategically minded professional who is passionate about shaping the future of urban mobility. You possess excellent technical leadership skills, with a track record of driving complex projects and raising the standards of those around you. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift, utilizing your problem-solving skills to guide your team through uncertainty. You are a natural mentor who communicates complex ideas clearly and empathetically, building strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**Your background**

* At least 5 years of experience working as a Data Scientist, with a proven track record of leading multi-month projects with measurable business impact.
* Strong command of classical ML techniques — regression, classification, ensemble methods, clustering, dimensionality reduction, time-series forecasting, causal inference and optimization techniques.
* Strong expertise in Python and data science libraries, along with deep proficiency in SQL and cloud architectures and services (e.g., AWS - SageMaker, S3, Lambda, ECR or Snowflake or Airflow).
* Proven experience mentoring other data scientists, raising technical standards, and advocating for software development best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to drive architectural decisions (such as pipelines, model registries, or feature stores) and represent data science at a senior stakeholder level.
* Solid software engineering foundations or an advanced degree (Masters/PhD) in a relevant field (e.g., machine learning or mobility).
* Experience with geospatial data (e.g., GeoPandas) or big data tools (e.g., PySpark) is highly preferred.
* Hands-on experience with MLOps — model deployment, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, experiment tracking and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Practical experience with Generative AI / LLMs — prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, embeddings, fine-tuning, and evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders in English.

This role is based in Bengaluru, India
  
  
**About Arrive**
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
Arrive is seeking a Data Scientist with a strong technical background to join our growing Data Science team in the AI & Analytics Experience. The purpose of this role is to deliver data science products and impactful solutions across the organization, playing a key role in advancing Arrive's data capabilities and ensuring data insights are effectively integrated into decision-making. This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage a modern data stack (including AWS, Snowflake, and DBT) and empower teams with self-service analytics (through Looker and Streamlit). This is an individual contributor position reporting to the Manager of Data Science within the DNA function. The team is based in Bengaluru, and key stakeholders include Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Distribution partners.
  
  
**How To Make An Impact**

* Contribute to end-to-end data science projects, from initial problem definition through to production deployment.
* Perform rigorous Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using statistical testing, distribution analysis, correlation studies, and visualization to uncover patterns and inform modeling strategy.
* Partner and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams on joint initiatives to deliver business value.
* Support the identification and resolution of technical hurdles in developing scalable data science solutions, collaborating with senior team members on best practices.
* Take shared ownership of developed solutions, ensuring their ongoing maintenance, reliability, and optimization.
* Champion data literacy across Arrive by supporting non-data professionals to develop their analytical capabilities.
* Prototype Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering etc.
* Stay curious by continuously learning and implementing modern data science trends and technologies to foster team-wide innovation.

**About You**
You are a collaborative, curious, and driven professional who is excited about solving complex urban mobility challenges. You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are skilled at managing shifting priorities with a focus on real-world impact. You are highly analytical, with a natural inclination to dive deep into data to uncover meaningful insights, and you possess a strong growth mindset – always seeking to learn and develop your skills. You enjoy working in a team-first environment where sharing knowledge and educating others is celebrated. You communicate with empathy, clarity, and respect, helping to shape our inclusive team culture.
  
  
**Your background**

* At least 3 years of experience working as a Data Scientist or in a highly analytical software engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience on Python and its data science ecosystem (for example Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-learn and TensorFlow/PyTorch).
* Proficiency in working with databases and SQL for data manipulation and analysis.
* Experience working with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Airflow) and familiarity with modern data workflows.
* Good understanding on MLOps concepts - CI/CD pipelines, model deployment and experiment tracking
* Solid knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and clean coding principles.
* A Software Engineering background or an advanced degree (Masters) in a relevant area (e.g., mobility or Machine Learning) is a plus.
* Good understanding on the concepts like LLM architecture, RAG, fine tuning, evaluation framework for generative AI systems.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders in English.

This role is based in Bengaluru, India
  
  
**About Arrive**
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

description:
