**Role Overview**
Empower India Data Science is seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Science - Paid Media Measurement & Media Mix Modeling (Marketing Analytics). This hands-on individual-contributor role is approximately 60% focused on paid media measurement and experimentation and 40% on Media Mix Modeling (MMM). The Senior Analyst will help ensure paid campaigns are configured for reliable measurement, trace how media activity is captured from platform setup through first-party outcomes, design and evaluate experiments, and use those learnings alongside MMM to assess marketing effectiveness and guide investment decisions.
  
  
This is an opportunity to help build a modern paid media measurement and MMM capability from the ground up for a large U.S. organization, with hands-on exposure to shaping tracking standards, experimentation, data workflows, and how measurement is operationalized at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up, traffic, or independently quality-assure paid media campaigns across paid search, paid social, programmatic display/video, CTV, and related channels; review campaign structure, audiences, placements, creatives, budgets, bidding, optimization events, naming conventions, and taxonomies that affect measurement.
* Translate campaign objectives into measurement plans and implement or validate conversion tracking, including KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution windows, UTMs/click IDs, pixels/tags, ad-server tracking, platform conversion APIs, enhanced/offline conversions, and first-party event integrations.
* Trace measurement end to end from impression or click through digital conversion and downstream first-party outcomes; diagnose broken or duplicate events, incorrect mappings, attribution differences, and discrepancies across media platforms, ad servers, web analytics, and internal reporting.
* Design and evaluate paid-media experiments such as A/B or platform tests, creative/audience/bidding tests, lift studies, geo or matched-market tests, and holdout-based incrementality studies; define hypotheses, treatment/control design, sample and power considerations, measurement windows, guardrails, and validity risks.
* Analyze paid-media performance and experiment results using measures such as reach, frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, ROAS, lift, incremental conversions, and cost per incremental outcome; distinguish attributed performance from incremental impact and recommend practical actions.
* Support recurring MMM by preparing, reconciling, and validating media, business, and external inputs; assist with model refreshes, diagnostics, data-quality checks, assumptions, and documentation across digital and traditional channels.
* Interpret MMM outputs including channel contribution, incremental impact, ROI/ROAS, marginal returns, response curves, and budget scenarios; connect MMM findings with experiment and campaign evidence, while clearly communicating uncertainty, limitations, and decision guardrails.
* Build repeatable dashboards, test readouts, QA standards, and measurement documentation, and partner with Media, Performance Marketing, MarTech, Web Analytics, Data Engineering, Finance, agencies, platforms, and measurement partners to improve measurement quality and adoption.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Economics, Marketing Analytics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, digital advertising operations, marketing analytics, marketing measurement, data science, or a closely related field.
* At least 4 years of direct hands-on experience setting up, trafficking, optimizing, or quality-assuring campaigns in major advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Microsoft Advertising, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360, Search Ads 360, or comparable platforms.
* Hands-on experience configuring and validating digital conversion measurement across tags/pixels, conversion events, tag managers, ad-server tracking, platform APIs, enhanced or offline conversions, web analytics, and first-party data integrations.
* Experience designing and analyzing paid-media experiments, including A/B tests, platform experiments, lift studies, geo or matched-market tests, and holdout/incrementality tests.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience supporting MMM or closely related econometric marketing measurement, including data preparation, model refresh or validation, output interpretation, and business application.
* Experience independently delivering complex measurement or analytics work and collaborating across Media, Marketing, MarTech, Analytics, Data Engineering, Finance, agencies, or external measurement partners; financial-services or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong command of paid-media measurement architecture, including campaign mechanics, conversion tracking, attribution windows, de-duplication, modeled conversions, server/API event feeds, first-party integrations, and cross-platform troubleshooting.
* Strong grounding in experimental design and causal measurement, including treatment/control design, randomization and holdouts, power and sample-size considerations, statistical significance, confidence intervals, lift, incrementality, and practical significance.
* Strong SQL and Python skills for extracting, joining, validating, analyzing, and automating marketing data; experience with web analytics, tag-management, and BI/visualization tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Tags, Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, or comparable tools.
* Working knowledge of MMM concepts and diagnostics, including adstock/carryover, saturation, seasonality, controls, multicollinearity, calibration, uncertainty, channel contribution, ROI/ROAS, marginal returns, response curves, and budget scenarios; ability to triangulate MMM findings with experimental evidence.
* Strong analytical problem solving, data-quality discipline, business judgment, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to identify measurement issues, explain uncertainty, and translate findings into clear actions.

title: GBM - Systematic Credit - Quantitative Engineering - VP - Bengaluru
description:
**Team Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Systematic Credit Team is a global, multi-disciplinary market-making group that leverages advanced quantitative methods, technology, and deep market insights to trade corporate bonds, credit derivatives, and Fixed Income ETFs.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of financial engineering, machine learning, and high-performance computing, our team in Bengaluru works in lockstep with global desks in New York, London, and Hong Kong. We design, backtest, and deploy systematic market-making strategies that provide liquidity, capture alpha, and manage risk in historically fragmented and over-the-counter (OTC) credit markets.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Quantitative Researcher at the Associate or Vice President level, you will drive the research agenda and infrastructure for our systematic credit market-making strategies. You will take ownership of the end-to-end quantitative pipeline—from sourcing and structuring complex credit datasets to engineering predictive features, building alpha models, and developing the core platforms that democratize signal generation across the broader team.
  
  
For candidates entering at the Vice President (VP) level, you will also be expected to lead key architectural decisions for our research platform, mentor junior researchers, and collaborate directly with global trading desks to transition models from research into production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Alpha Generation & Strategy Development: Conduct rigorous statistical research to identify predictive signals (alphas) across corporate bonds and credit ETFs. Apply advanced time-series analysis, machine learning, and alternative data processing to model credit spread dynamics.
* Consolidated Research-Grade Data Framework & Pipeline: Architect and build a consolidated, high-performance, research-grade data framework and pipeline to back signal generation. Ingest, clean, and normalize diverse, noisy credit datasets (e.g., TRACE, dealer runs, electronic communication network feeds) to establish a robust "Golden Source" for quantitative research.
* AI-Driven Self-Service Signal Backtesting Platform: Design, develop, and maintain an open, scalable, AI-based platform that allows researchers and traders to seamlessly upload signal ideas, leverage machine learning for automated parameter tuning, and backtest them against a standardized, point-in-time, and bias-free simulation framework.
* Quantitative Infrastructure & Tooling: Collaborate with quantitative developers to build and scale backtesting engines, simulation frameworks, and production-grade analytics libraries. Ensure research code is modular, well-tested, and optimized for high-performance computing environments.

**Required Experience & Education**

* Education: Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative STEM discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or Financial Engineering).

**Experience**

* 6+ years of experience with a proven track record of developing systematic trading strategies or advanced quantitative models (ideally within Fixed Income, Credit, or Macro).

**Core Competencies & Technical Skills**

* Quantitative & Fixed Income Foundations: Deep understanding of probability, statistics, linear algebra, and time-series analysis, paired with a strong conceptual grasp of bond pricing, yield-to-price conversions, credit spreads, and interest rate risk (duration/convexity).
* Advanced Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-Learn) with a software engineering mindset—combining rapid mathematical prototyping with clean, modular, and well-documented code. Object-oriented programming in C++ or Java is highly desirable.
* Data Engineering & Quantitative Toolkit: Experience managing large-scale, noisy, and unstructured datasets using SQL and high-performance time-series databases (e.g., KDB+/Q, ClickHouse). Proficient in applying machine learning techniques (regression, tree-based models, neural networks) to financial data.
* Intellectual Honesty & Collaborative Communication: Driven to understand market mechanics rather than just curve-fitting. Possesses the analytical honesty to challenge assumptions, iterate on failed hypotheses, and translate complex quantitative concepts into clear, actionable insights for global stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience researching systematic corporate bond or credit derivatives strategies.
* Experience building self-service quantitative research platforms, APIs, or shared backtesting frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with KDB+/Q or managing large-scale, tick-level financial datasets.

We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. title: Applied Scientist II, Detail Page
description:
**Description**
Amazon.com’s Product Detail Page team is looking for talented, motivated and passionate applied scientist to be part of the design and development of a highly scalable multi-tiered shopping application to provide the best possible online shopping experience for Amazon customers world-wide. Our team is comprised of talented applied scientists, developers, testers, program managers, designers and product managers tasked with the singular goal to create THE world's best buying experience.
  
  
Scientists on this team develop the next-generation technologies and experiences that change how millions interact and shop online. To provide the best possible online shopping at the scale of the web requires ideas from every area of computer science, including distributed computing, large-scale system design, machine learning, natural language processing, data compression and user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. We need our scientists to be versatile and always eager to tackle new problems as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
Our team leverages sophisticated econometric, machine learning, and big data technologies to help customers to discover the right products at the right prices from millions of trusted sellers billions of times a day. If you are looking for a career-defining opportunity on one of the most customer centric and business impacting teams within Amazon, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to help build the next generation of Detail Page optimization algorithms. These new set of algorithms will incorporate the continually changing preferences of our customers and continue to scale with numerous new programs that Amazon is introducing for our customers. You will work with multiple Amazon businesses and programs to identify big business opportunities and propose new business features and technical systems to improve customer experience on Amazon Detail Page, Search Page and many other widgets throughout the website. You will be responsible for the quality of algorithm design and will get the opportunity to present your ideas and share results of your deliverables with Amazon executives on a frequent basis. **Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
  
  
Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
  
  
**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
  
  
**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:**
We are seeking a forecaster to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics & Insights (CA&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This individual contributor role is responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving multiple forecast types across Ex-US markets - including short-term in-market demand forecasts, long-term strategic forecasts, patient-based epidemiology forecasts, and launch and event scenarios - in partnership with affiliate forecasting leads. The Senior Analyst is accountable for forecast model integrity, assumption discipline, and the business relevance of outputs delivered into brand planning, S&OP, and portfolio cycles.
  
  
**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Forecast Model Development and Delivery:**

* Build and maintain a portfolio of forecasts across multiple IBU markets and brands, spanning short-term tactical forecasts (24-36 months), long-term strategic forecasts (10+ years), in-line product forecasts, and pipeline and BD forecasts.
* Apply the appropriate forecast methodology to each disease area, including patient-based approaches (prevalence, incidence, disease progression), demand-based approaches (trend, time-series, regression, exponential smoothing), and hybrid models that integrate both.
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses for market events, competitive entries, LOEs, pricing changes, indication expansions, and access scenarios across IBU geographies.
* Maintain rigorous assumption documentation, version control, and audit trails for every forecast cycle, supporting reproducibility and review by affiliate and global stakeholders.
* Track forecast accuracy across cycles, perform variance analyses against actuals, and translate learnings into improved drivers and assumptions for the next cycle.

**Data, Methodology, and Tooling:**

* Work with IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, syndicated subnational data, claims, prescription data, and epidemiology sources to build robust market and patient views across Ex-US geographies.
* Apply statistical and machine learning techniques where appropriate - including ARIMA, exponential smoothing, regression (single and multivariate), Prophet, and other time-series methods - to enhance forecast accuracy for in-market brands.
* Build forecast outputs and tracking dashboards in Tableau or Power BI; structure model files in Excel and, where applicable, in Python or R for automation and reproducibility.

**Stakeholder Partnership and Communication:**

* Partner with affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global IBU stakeholders to clarify intake, align on methodology, and walk through outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios.
* Translate model outputs into clear narratives, decision-grade slides, and assumption summaries tailored to commercial, finance, and senior leadership audiences.
* Represent the GCC forecasting pod in cross-functional working sessions for brand planning, S&OP, LRP, and ad-hoc strategic questions.

**Process Improvement and Operational Excellence:**

* Identify opportunities to automate recurring forecast updates, standardize templates across markets and brands, and build reusable assumption libraries that improve speed and consistency.
* Contribute to building capability within the GCC pod, including knowledge sharing, documentation of best practices, and onboarding support for new analysts.
* Leverage AI and GenAI tools to accelerate data preparation, assumption research, deviation reasoning, and narrative generation within forecasting workflows.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience:**
**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.

**Experience:**

* 3-5 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or related quantitative areas.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining multiple forecast types - including prevalence and disease-progression (patient-based) models and demand-based models, across short-term and long-term, in-line and launch horizons - across more than one market.
* Experience supporting Ex-US markets is required, particularly EU markets; exposure to Asian or Latin American markets is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of pharma data assets such as IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, prescription and claims data, and epidemiology sources for Ex-US markets.
* Advanced Excel skills for forecast model construction are required.
* Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for forecast tracking, scenario reporting, and commercial performance dashboard development.
* Familiarity with cloud analytics environments (Databricks, AWS, Azure) and forecasting platforms (e.g., Anaplan, JDA/Blue Yonder, SAP IBP) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple forecast cycles simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, matrixed environment.
* Working knowledge of coding techniques such as Python, R, or SAS for data preparation, time-series analysis, and automation is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* **Pharmaceutical Domain Knowledge –:**
  Understands demand drivers, patient flow, market events, lifecycle stages, and competitive dynamics across therapy areas and Ex-US markets.
* **Analytical Rigor –:**
  Applies disciplined assumption management, sensitivity analysis, and accuracy tracking to every forecast deliverable.
* **Stakeholder Partnership –:**
  Builds trusted working relationships with affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global partners across multiple time zones.
* **Data Storytelling –:**
  Distils forecast outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios into clear narratives with practical business implications and decision points.
* **Operational Excellence –:**
  Identifies and implements opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale forecasting workflows using modern tools and practices.
* **Cross-Cultural Communication –:**
  Fluent communicator across India-EU-Asia-LatAm time zones; adapts style effectively for technical and commercial audiences.
* Operational Excellence — Identifies and implements opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale forecasting workflows using modern tools and engineering practices.
* Cross-Cultural Communication — Fluent communicator across India-EU-Asia-LatAm time zones; adapts style effectively for technical and commercial audiences

**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:**
In alignment with Takeda’s Values-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviors
  
  

* Act with Integrity — Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
* Collaborate Cross-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC-IBU team workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
* Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* Embrace Learning — Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self-driven development.

**BENEFITS:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are

title: Transport Modeler
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
Are you enthusiastic about how transportation, land use, socioeconomics, and technology intersect and its real-world impacts on people’s lives and communities? Do you have a passion to empower regional planning policies and decisions with state-of-the-art transportation planning tools? Are you ready to take on the challenge to deliver highly innovative transportation planning projects that will shape and inspire a sustainable, prosperous, and resilient future? If so, consider joining our innovative Planning team at WSP ! for Canada Business. We are looking for a Junior or Intermediate Transportation Planner/Engineer/Data Scientist to join our team.
  
  
We focus on the development and application of travel demand models to support multi-modal transportation planning and policy projects. We specialize in advanced, activity-based demand modelling techniques to forecast regional population travel patterns and future transportation networks given proposed land uses, transportation infrastructure, and policies. Our proven record for developing industry-leading solutions include the Cities, Municipalities and Regional Travel Demand Model and its implementations. We are trusted advisors and close collaborators with municipal, regional, and provincial governments, transportation agencies, and academia.
  
  
We are also actively growing Transportation Planning practice that is rooted in our team’s strong data analytics and visualization capabilities. This involves developing bespoke software solutions to help clients analyze large and complex data sources to derive useful insights and answer complex questions.
  
  
As a member of the GCC Planning team, you will be part of a forward-thinking team that seeks to improve transportation mobility through the delivery of travel demand models and data-driven insights. Depending on the project, work may involve a combination of macro/meso/microscopic modelling, and data science. You will also be part of the broader, multi-disciplinary Transportation Planning and Science practice and will closely collaborate with other planners and engineers on transportation master plans, secondary plans, environmental assessments, policy studies, and other transportation planning projects.
  
  
We offer a team-focused environment that encourages rapid career growth, flexible work arrangements, and a highly competitive benefits package. Join us and be part of a leading national professional services firm that is committed to designing and planning sustainable cities!
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
**What Skills and Qualifications are needed?**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Urban Planning, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline, and/or 1-3 years of equivalent work experience
* Demonstrable experience with computer programming (preferably Python and/or R)
* Strong and proven background in statistics and data analysis
* Strong oral and technical writing communication skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* A great fit working within our close-knit team culture
* Knowledge of travel demand model design and application, including experience with activity-based models and platforms
* Proficiency with travel demand modelling software (EMME, VISUM, TransCAD, Cube)

* Experience applying statistical analyses for model estimation and calibration
* Experience building and applying machine learning models
* Experience with data visualization front-end development using HTML, CSS, and common web libraries and frameworks

* Compiling and analyzing transportation data;
* Undertaking transportation studies, including complex traffic operations studies including capacity analysis using modeling tools such as Synchro/SimTraffic, Vissim, Aimsun Next;
* Conduct traffic impact studies, traffic signal and intersection improvement evaluations, traffic management plan evaluations and safety reviews;
* Liaising with team members;
* Preparing technical reports;
* Other duties as assigned/required.

* Post-secondary education in Civil Engineering or Transportation Engineering from an accredited university;
* Excellent attention to detail

* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

* Design, implement, and maintain quantitative models, tools, and interest rate risk frameworks aligned to IRRBB best practices.
* Build robust analytics for sensitivity, stress, and scenarios analysis across portfolios and entities.
* Produce and enhance methodologies for interest rate risk metrics, partner closely with stakeholders across teams.
* Develop and uplift models to reflect evolving business needs, maintain model documentation and implementation, support regulatory inquiries and second-line validation.
* Deliver clear presentations, reports, and explain related to projects for discussion with managers and team.

* Experience in quantitative finance role, building risk system and use of AI-based tools in development is a plus.
* A self-starter, should have ability to work independently as well as thrive in a team environment.

* Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !
  
  
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
  
  
The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
(FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.
* Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way.
* AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders.
* Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact.
* Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date.
* AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours.
* Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time.
* Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap.
* Architecture Standards & Playbooks: Demonstrated expertise in establishing system frameworks like the Agent Development Kit (ADK), authoring operational playbooks, and drafting technical guidelines. 1 2
* Reusable Assets Contribution: Strong background in modular architectures, ensuring custom-built implementations are published as reusable internal marketplace assets instead of isolated, unmanaged components.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 6 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you’ve already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You’re imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems.
* Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless.
* Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth.
* Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
  
  
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**Location - Bangalore (Hybrid)**

**Notice Period - Immediate Joiners (upto 15days)**

**About us**

Zemoso is an AI-native product engineering company helping Fortune 500 companies and

high-growth enterprises turn complex ideas into production.

We work with enterprise teams to build production-grade AI agents for real business workflows,

driving measurable outcomes and ROI. We also help engineering organizations modernize how

software is built, applying AI across the SDLC to move from idea to production faster.

Zemoso has contributed to over $10 billion in value creation across healthcare, financial

services, logistics, biotech, retail, and e-commerce.

We are a 3x Deloitte Fast 50 company and an O'Reilly Architectural Katas winner. Our

technology partnerships include Anthropic, Databricks, Google Cloud and AWS.

**Role overview**

We are hiring a Senior Product Analyst with 5+ years of experience in product analytics,

experimentation and causal inference to join our team in Bangalore. You will turn ambiguous

product questions into rigorous analytical frameworks, partner with Product, Design, and

Engineering to define KPIs, and influence product roadmaps with data-driven insights.

**What You will do**

● Play the role of Senior Product Analyst, acting as the primary analytics thought partner to

Product, Engineering, and Science teams within cross-functional pod structures.

● Scope ambiguous product questions with stakeholders, define North Star metrics,

establish success and guardrail metrics, and deliver unbiased findings that directly inform

roadmap decisions.

● Design and execute A/B experiments end-to-end: define target audiences, determine

traffic sizing, execute power analysis, implement variance reduction (CUPED), manage

multiple-comparison corrections, and monitor metrics post-launch.

● Guide experiment tracking setup by defining event action requirements, dropping proper

experiment tags (XT tags), and validating telemetry pipelines before data analysis begins.

● Apply causal inference techniques and Quasi-Experimental Alternatives to measure

feature impact where randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are unfeasible or unethical.

● Perform deep-dive product analytics—including multi-step funnel optimization, cohort

tracking, and retention analysis—to pinpoint drop-offs and drive feature prioritization.

● Lead strategic analysis beyond standard experiment readouts, including quarterly strategy

planning, opportunity sizing, and metric deep dives to uncover customer needs.

● Build dashboards and consolidate findings into executive-ready experiment readouts to

drive go/no-go launch decisions in leadership reviews.

● Work with data engineers to design, build, test, and monitor scalable, reusable data

pipelines for ongoing experimentation and analytics workflows.

**Basic Qualifications**

● Experience: 5+ years.

● Hands-on experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in product analytics, preferably

in cross border e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, search domains or logistics.

● Strong experience designing and analyzing A/B experiments: power analysis, hypothesis

and significance testing, CUPED, Bonferroni correction.

● Deep expertise in causal inference methods and Quasi-Experimental Alternatives,

specifically:

○ Regression Discontinuity (RDD): Exploits administrative cutoffs or scoring rules

to mimic local randomization.

○ Propensity Score Matching: Statistically balances confounding covariates

between self-selected groups.

○ Difference-in-Differences (DiD): Compares treatment and control trends over

time, adjusting for baseline offsets.

○ Synthetic Controls: Constructs a weighted combination of unexposed units to

model a perfect counterfactual.

● Advanced SQL and coding experience in Python (PySpark a plus) on large data sets.

● Experience with tracking architecture, validating event telemetry, and defining tracking

requirements for engineering teams.

● Experience with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention analysis, KPI design, North

Star metrics, and opportunity sizing.

● Experience with data warehouse and pipeline tools such as Snowflake, Databricks and

Apache Airflow.

● Experience building dashboards in BI tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, Sigma or

Metabase, and with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude.

● Strong communication and conflict management skills, with a track record of driving

transparency via tools like Airtable and presenting unbiased insights to cross-functional

leadership.

● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a

related quantitative field.

**Nice to have Qualifications**

● Experience with search analytics, including autocomplete optimization, ranking/relevance

model evaluations, or agentic/conversational search experiences.

● Familiarity with recommendation systems: collaborative filtering, content-based and hybrid

approaches, applied to personalization use cases.

● Exposure to Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM application development in

Python, including vector databases and retrieval pipelines.

● Experience building automated reporting workflows that reduce manual analyst effort.

● Experience with Git/GitHub for version-controlled analytics code.

title: Lead AI Engr
description:
**Job Description**
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
  
  
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
  
  
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
  
  
Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.
  
  
As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead AI Engineer – Mechanical Design, CFD & Structural Analysis**
We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer with strong expertise in mechanical design, computational fluid dynamics, and structural analysis to join the Aerospace Advanced & Applied Technology group. In this role, you will develop and deploy AI-enabled engineering solutions that accelerate simulation workflows, improve design exploration, enhance prediction accuracy, and support technology insertion for aircraft propulsion engines, power systems, and related mechanical components. You will work with product architects, simulation specialists, product chiefs, Chief Engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate advanced analytics, AI/ML methods, and physics-based insights into practical engineering solutions that create measurable business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and deployment of AI/ML-enabled methods for mechanical design, CFD, structural analysis, and simulation-driven product development.
* Build surrogate models, reduced-order models, physics-informed models, optimization frameworks, and automation workflows for engineering applications.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to improve simulation efficiency, design exploration, predictive capability and engineering decision-making.
* Collaborate with product architects, Chief Engineers, Subject specialists, and cross-functional teams to identify high-value engineering problems and convert them into scalable AI-enabled solutions.
* Interpret CFD and structural analysis results, validate model assumptions, assess technical risks, and recommend design improvements based on data and physics-based insights.
* Automate engineering workflows including data extraction, preprocessing, model training, post-processing, visualization, and report generation.
* Drive adoption of advanced AI/ML engineering methods across teams through technical leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement.
* Ensure solutions are technically robust, explainable, traceable, and aligned with aerospace engineering quality, validation, and business requirements.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mechanics, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related discipline from a reputed university.
* 12 to 20 years of relevant experience in mechanical design, CFD, structural analysis, simulation-led product development, engineering automation, or AI/ML-enabled engineering applications.
* Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, turbomachinery, solid mechanics, finite element methods, numerical methods, design optimization, and engineering statistics.
* Hands-on experience with CFD and structural analysis workflows, including model setup, mesh strategy, solver execution, post-processing, validation, and interpretation of results.
* Proven experience applying AI/ML methods to mechanical engineering problems using simulation, experimental, operational, or multi-physics engineering datasets.
* Experience developing surrogate models, reduced-order models, physics-informed machine learning models, response surface models, uncertainty quantification methods, or optimization frameworks.
* Strong programming capability in Python and practical experience with AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to automate engineering workflows for geometry handling, meshing, solver setup, data extraction, model training, post-processing, visualization, and reporting.
* Good understanding of gas turbine engine components, aerospace mechanical systems, propulsion and power system technologies, and simulation-driven product development practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical priorities, deliver development milestones, and work effectively in ambiguous engineering environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with commercial and open-source CFD, FEA, and mechanical design tools such as ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, Abaqus, ANSYS Mechanical, Nastran, HyperMesh, NX, Creo, CATIA, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience in aircraft propulsion systems, turbomachinery, thermal systems, power systems, or aerospace component development, testing, and certification processes.
* Familiarity with aerospace design practices, industry standards, and regulatory requirements related to engine design, structural integrity, verification, validation, and certification.
* Knowledge of machine learning methods such as regression, classification, neural networks, Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimization, variational autoencoders, graph neural networks, reinforcement learning, or generative AI for engineering applications.
* Exposure to physics-informed neural networks, neural operators, AI-assisted solver acceleration, digital twins, reduced-order models, and simulation-based design optimization.
* Experience handling large engineering datasets, including data cleaning, feature engineering, model training, validation, error analysis, traceability, and deployment of reusable AI/ML workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud or HPC environments, version control, model lifecycle management, engineering data management, and collaborative software development practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers, guiding technical problem solving, and influencing adoption of new AI-enabled engineering methods across teams.

**What We Value**

* A strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex technical initiatives from concept to deployment.
* Curiosity to adopt emerging AI/ML technologies and apply them responsibly to aerospace engineering challenges.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to mentoring, knowledge sharing, and building reusable engineering capabilities.
* Innovative and creative mindset
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects efficiently, ensuring timely delivery of development milestones.

Honeywell Aerospace never requests or accepts money from candidates at any stage of the hiring process. Any demand for payment in exchange for employment opportunities is fraudulent and should be reported immediately to local law enforcement authorities

title: AI Senior Engineer
description:
****Description****
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own client engagements end to end — technical discovery, solution architecture, hands-on build, and delivery — acting as the technical authority on feasibility.
* Translate ambiguous real-world problems into concrete perception and robotics ML architectures; lead demos and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Design and build CV and perception systems — detection, segmentation, pose estimation — on the 3D geometry underneath (SE(3), camera models, projection, coordinate frames).
* Own sensor calibration and fusion — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and LiDAR–camera — plus LiDAR processing (registration, ground segmentation, object detection).
* Design egocentric data collection pipelines using wrist/head-mounted cameras, depth sensors, and IMU for robot learning.
* Bridge simulation and deployment via domain randomisation, sim setup, and sim-to-real gap analysis.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate VLA models, and fine-tune large pretrained models under data and compute constraints.
* Build supporting services — agentic loops, REST/gRPC APIs, and PostgreSQL — to expose model inference and robotics services.
* Mentor engineers, drive principled decisions (diagnose before solving), and translate current research into practical client implications.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years in robotics ML, computer vision, or technical solutions engineering.
* Strong CV and perception — detection, segmentation, pose estimation, optical flow.
* Solid 3D geometry — SE(3) transformations, camera models, projection, coordinate frames.
* Sensor calibration — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and multi-modal alignment.
* LiDAR processing and sensor fusion, including LiDAR–camera calibration.
* Sim-to-real experience — domain randomisation and sim environments (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or Unity Robotics Hub).
* Conceptual grasp of VLA architectures and the current SOTA landscape.
* Strong Python (PyTorch); able to read and implement research papers.
* Prior client-facing or presales technical experience.
* Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Agentic systems and prompt engineering — tool-use agents and multi-step planners.
* API development (REST/gRPC, Docker, basic CI/CD) and PostgreSQL.
* ROS / ROS2 or equivalent robotics middleware.
* C# for Unity-based simulation and tooling.
* Fine-tuning large pretrained models under data/compute constraints.
* Edge/onboard optimisation — TensorRT, ONNX, quantisation.
* RL / RLHF, motion planning, kinematics, or URDF.
* Hands-on with robot hardware (Franka, UR, Unitree, or similar).
* Research orientation — tracks arXiv, forms opinions from first principles.
* Publications, open-source work, or notable projects in robot learning or Physical AI.

Technical Stack
  
  

* Languages: Python (PyTorch)
* Perception / 3D: OpenCV, Open3D, PCL, point cloud processing
* Simulation: Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Unity Robotics Hub
* Robotics Middleware: ROS / ROS2
* Models: VLA models (RT-2, OpenVLA, π₀, Octo), ViTs, multimodal, hosted and open-source
* Deployment: REST/gRPC, Docker, PostgreSQL; TensorRT / ONNX for edge
* Core Areas: CV and perception, 3D geometry, calibration, LiDAR, sensor fusion, sim-to-real, agentic systems

Success Measures
  
  

* Client engagements delivered with clear architecture, working perception/robotics systems, and evaluation coverage.
* Reusable solution patterns and accelerators created from recurring engagement needs.
* Robust calibration, data collection, and sim-to-real workflows that transfer reliably to real hardware.
* Sound VLA and model-selection/fine-tuning decisions, grounded in the current SOTA landscape.
* Effective mentorship and principled technical guidance across the Technical Solutions team.

title: Capacity Planner AMZL, AMZL
description:
**Description**
Amazon Logistics India (IN AMZL) is looking for a driven and analytical professional to join the Short Term Capacity Planning team. This role sits at the intersection of operations, data analytics, and strategic planning — responsible for ensuring the right capacity is available across VAN and BIKE service networks to meet customer promise while optimizing cost-to-serve.
  
  
The Short Term Capacity Planner will own near-term capacity planning across DSP, Hubs, AMFLEX, and emerging channels, ensuring delivery sufficiency across all zones and stations in India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Capacity Planning & Forecasting
  
  
Own weekly and daily capacity plans across all channels (DSP, hubs, AMFLEX, and emerging) for the India network
  
  
Develop and maintain short-term (D-1, D-7) capacity plans aligned with volume forecasts
  
  
Build cycle-level volume predictions and translate them into actionable block and route plans
  
  
Lead capacity planning for High Volume Events (HVEs) including Prime Day, ART events, and peak seasons, ensuring cost and capacity sufficiency
  
  
Performance Monitoring & Analytics
  
  
Track and analyze key capacity metrics including DPPH (Deliveries Per Productive Hour), assignment compliance, block mix, and ROBL (Return-on-Business-Load) across zones
  
  
Conduct Daily Business Reviews (DBR), Weekly Business Reviews (WBR), and Monthly Business Reviews (MBR) with actionable insights
  
  
Identify capacity gaps, over/under-supply situations, and recommend corrective actions proactively
  
  
Block Mix & Cost Optimization
  
  
Optimize block mix across VAN and BIKE channels to reduce cost-to-serve while maintaining service levels
  
  
Manage DSP, eDSP, and pickup pricing strategies to eliminate defects and improve productivity
  
  
Drive initiatives to improve assignment compliance and reduce unplanned shipments
  
  
Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  
Partner with Routing, Supply Planning, and Operations teams to align capacity inputs with routing configurations and station-level constraints

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Senior Applied Value Engineer - UKI Energy, Oil & Gas
description:

With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. * Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: Group Specialist - Threat Detection
description:
**Job Description**
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****

* Develop and operationalize AI/ML-based threat detection models across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments.
* Operationalise threat intelligence feeds into AI-driven detection pipelines, ensuring alignment with MITRE ATT&CK TTPs.
* Design, develop, and deploy detection use cases across SIEM and XDR platforms.
* Build, maintain, and continuously tune detection rules, KQL queries, and analytics for improved detection fidelity.
* Design and enhance UEBA (User and Entity Behaviour Analytics) models to detect anomalies, insider threats, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Collaborate with red team and adversary simulation functions to validate detection coverage against real-world attack scenarios.
* Drive proactive threat hunting by developing automated workflows leveraging AI-assisted query generation and anomaly detection.
* Continuously evaluate detection effectiveness, reduce false positives, and improve signal-to-noise ratio.
* Integrate multiple threat intelligence sources and contextual data to enrich detections and improve response outcomes.
* Contribute to the development of threat detection standards, frameworks, and best practices.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of evolving threats, adversary techniques, and detection technologies to continuously strengthen the organization’s cyber defense capabilities.
* Act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in harmony with DP World’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**
**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on threat detection, threat hunting, or detection engineering.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM/XDR platforms, preferably Microsoft Sentinel and Falcon /Cortex/Stellar Cyber/Defender XDR.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Experience in developing detection logic, analytics, and threat hunting queries (e.g., KQL).
* Experience in AI/ML applications for cybersecurity, including anomaly detection and behavioural analytics.
* Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and integrating intelligence into detection workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud security (Azure, AWS), endpoint security, and identity-based threat detection.
* Relevant certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCED, AZ-500, SC-200, or equivalent are preferred.
* Experience in multinational environments is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams (SOC, Red Team, Engineering).
* Proactive mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Continuous learning attitude, especially in AI and emerging cyber threats.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in KQL (Kusto Query Language) and detection rule development.
* Strong understanding of SIEM, XDR, EDR technologies.
* Experience with UEBA and behavioural analytics platforms.
* Hands-on experience of AI/ML concepts applied to cybersecurity (anomaly detection, classification models).
* Understanding of log sources and telemetry across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) for automation and analysis.
* Experience with threat hunting frameworks and automation tools.
* Strong knowledge of cyber threats, attack techniques, and detection strategies.

title: Application Engineer (AI Automation)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer for AI Automation**
, you will be at the clinical edge of our intelligence layer. This isn't just about writing code; it's about architecting the nervous system of our automated enterprise. You will bridge the gap between heavy-duty enterprise platforms (Salesforce, Zuora, ServiceNow) and the next generation of Agentic AI.
  
  
Your primary mission will be building high-performance
**Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
servers that allow AI agents to interact deeply with complex business logic—specifically within the Salesforce ecosystem (Quote, Opportunity, and Renewal services). You’ll move from building RAG-based retrieval to orchestrating
**Agent-to-Agent communication**
, creating a seamless autonomous workflow across our tech stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect MCP Servers: Design and implement robust MCP servers to expose Salesforce services (Quote, Opportunity, Renewal) and other core platforms to AI agents.
* Data Model Synthesis: Rapidly decompose the data models of enterprise applications like Zuora, Salesforce, and ServiceNow to build effective schemas for AI interaction.
* Build AI Pipelines: Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and AI agents that can execute complex tasks with minimal human intervention.
* Agentic Orchestration: Lead the transition from simple chatbots to Agentic AI, focusing on multi-agent collaboration and autonomous "Agent-to-Agent" communication.
* Integration Engineering: Build and maintain secure, scalable integrations using REST APIs across disparate cloud environments.
* Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert for AI automation, guiding the evolution of our automation strategy and mentoring junior engineers.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in professional software engineering.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python (for AI/ML orchestration) and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java (for enterprise services).
* Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud (Apex knowledge is a plus, but understanding the API/Object model is mandatory).
* AI Specialization: Proven experience building AI agents using MCP (Model Context Protocol) and implementing RAG architectures.
* API Mastery: Deep expertise in designing and consuming RESTful APIs and handling complex authentication/OAuth flows.
* Autonomy: A "hunter" mindset for information—you can pick up a new tool like Zuora, read the docs, and understand the underlying data relationships without needing a guided tour.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
* Background in SalesOps automation (specifically Quote-to-Cash processes).
* Contributions to open-source MCP servers or AI frameworks.

**The Future of This Role**
This role is designed for an engineer who wants to move beyond "GPT wrappers." You will eventually be responsible for building a decentralized network of agents where a "Sales Agent" can autonomously negotiate data with a "Billing Agent" (Zuora) and a "Contract Agent" (ServiceNow) to close renewals without manual data entry.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Planning & Inventory Management Operations Analyst is responsible for executing and supporting daily planning and inventory management processes that ensure product availability, inventory accuracy, and operational efficiency. The role focuses on inventory monitoring, demand and supply planning operations, exception management, operational reporting, data governance, and process improvement initiatives. The analyst will collaborate with Planning, Stores, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Merchandising, and Vendor Management teams to maintain inventory health, improve planning effectiveness, and support business objectives through data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Planning and Inventory Management Operations**

* Monitor planning/Inventory system outputs and identify supply-demand imbalances, inventory gaps, and replenishment exceptions.
* Maintain inventory and planning parameters, replenishment settings, lead times, and inventory policies within upstream and downstream systems.
* Support forecast reviews, stores and field team activities, seasonal planning and retail strategy activities through data analysis and reporting.
* Ensure data integrity and compliance with established operational processes.
* Monitor inventory levels across warehouses, distribution centers, suppliers, and fulfillment locations.
* Analyze inventory health, stock availability, excess inventory, aging inventory, and inventory risks.
* Execute inventory correction actions and coordinate with stakeholders to address inventory exceptions.
* Investigate inventory variances, transaction discrepancies, and root causes impacting inventory accuracy.
* Support inventory audits, reconciliation activities, and inventory governance processes.

**Reporting & Business Analytics**

* Develop, maintain, and automate operational reports, dashboards, and scorecards.
* Analyze trends related to inventory performance, replenishment effectiveness, and service levels.
* Conduct root cause analysis for inventory shortages, excess inventory, and planning exceptions.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve inventory productivity and operational efficiency.
* Prepare business reviews and operational performance presentations for leadership teams.

**Process & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Stores/Field Teams, Logistics, Finance, and Operations teams to resolve inventory and planning issues.
* Participate in operational reviews and inventory governance meetings.
* Support escalation management for inventory shortages, supply/demand constraints, and service risks.
* Ensure compliance with inventory management policies, controls, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Continuous Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and eliminate operational inefficiencies.
* Support process improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization and planning effectiveness.
* Participate in system implementations, testing, pilots and process documentation.
* Drive data quality improvement initiatives across planning and inventory systems.
* Recommend enhancements to reporting, dashboards, and planning workflows.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations/Retail Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* MBA or relevant Supply Chain certification preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Planning Operations, Inventory Management, Supply Chain Operations, or Business Operations.
* Experience managing inventory and planning-related KPIs and operational reporting.

**Reporting & Analytics Tools –**
Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, Macros)
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Functional Competencies: Inventory & Planning Management Operations, Replenishment Planning, Inventory Analysis, Supply Chain Analytics, Operational Reporting, KPI Management, Data Governance
* Behavioral Competencies: Analytical Thinking, Problem Solving, Attention to Detail, Stakeholder Management, Communication Skills, Process Excellence Mindset, Collaboration & Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, Ownership & Accountability
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Inventory Accuracy, Inventory Health Score, Excess & Obsolete Inventory Reduction, Planning Exception Resolution Time, Replenishment SLA Adherence, Inventory Turns, Forecast Consumption Accuracy, Reporting Accuracy & Timeliness, Data Quality and Master Data Compliance, Process Compliance and Audit Readiness

**Success Profile**
A successful Planning & Inventory Management Operations Analyst demonstrates strong operational discipline, analytical problem-solving, and expertise in planning and inventory systems. The individual proactively identifies inventory risks, improves operational processes through automation and insights, maintains data accuracy, and enables efficient inventory management that supports customer service goals and business growth.
