title: Senior Researcher - Self-Evolving Agentic Systems
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Research India is a leading research lab advancing innovation across areas including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Theory, Technology and Empowerment, and Systems. Established two decades ago, the lab has been at the forefront of computer science research in India and is home to researchers and impactful projects.
  
  
AI agents are moving beyond fixed prompts and static policies. They can now plan, use tools, write code, and work across long, multi-step tasks. However, most agents still cannot continuously improve through their own experience, learn from failures, or adapt while operating.
  
  
Our team is building
**self-evolving agentic systems**
: agents that improve their own policies, skills, memory, and scaffolding through interaction, feedback, and reinforcement learning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a
**Senior Researcher – Self-Evolving Agentic Systems**
, you will advance the state of the art in how LLM-based agents learn and adapt. You will work across the full stack, from designing reinforcement learning algorithms and reward signals to building environments and evaluations and translating research ideas into systems that operate at scale.
  
  
You will collaborate with researchers and engineers across Microsoft Research India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to contribute to both the research community and products used by millions of people.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who**

* Are passionate about advancing the state of the art in reinforcement learning, LLM post-training, and autonomous agents.
* Have a strong research track record demonstrated through publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM, or similar venues, or through impactful open-source contributions.
* Combine scientific rigor with strong engineering skills and enjoy turning research ideas into working systems.
* Thrive in a highly collaborative research environment.
* Take end-to-end ownership of complex, open-ended research problems.

**Qualifications**
Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead research on self-evolving agents, including self-improvement loops, experience-driven learning, self-generated curricula, and automatic refinement of agent policies, tools, and memory.
* Design and apply reinforcement learning methods for LLM-based agents, including reward modeling, learning from verifiable and AI feedback, and credit assignment over long, multi-step tasks.
* Build scalable training and evaluation environments for agentic tasks such as coding, tool use, web and computer use, and knowledge work.
* Develop rigorous benchmarks and evaluation methods that measure agent capability, robustness, safety, and improvement over time.
* Form hypotheses, design experiments, and iterate quickly on model and agent performance.
* Publish at top-tier venues, release open-source artifacts, and help shape the research agenda in agentic AI.
* Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to move research advances into real-world systems.
* Mentor interns and early-career researchers and contribute to Microsoft Research India’s academic engagement.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 1+ years of software engineering or research experience.
* Experience with reinforcement learning and LLMs.
* Strong research track record in machine learning, computer systems, or a closely related area.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, or other impactful outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building and scaling large AI systems.
* Experience applying reinforcement learning to AI models and agents.
* Experience with reward modeling, reinforcement learning, or other post-training techniques.
* Hands-on experience building datasets for LLM, VLM, or multimodal model pre-training or post-training.
* Experience with synthetic data, model graders, reward signals, hard-example mining, active learning, or data-mixture optimization.
* Experience building feedback loops that connect evaluation, failure mining, data generation, and training.
* Experience with multimodal or agentic datasets, including text, web, GUI, tool-use, or interaction trajectories.

How to Apply
  
  
Please apply using the application link above. In addition, please send an email to the Hiring Committee at
**seas-hiring-msri@microsoft.com**
.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Applied Scientist II, Last Mile Science
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s Last Mile Team is looking for a passionate individual with strong optimization and analytical skills to join its Last Mile Science team in the endeavor of designing and improving the most complex planning of delivery network in the world. Last Mile builds global solutions that enable Amazon to attract an elastic supply of drivers, companies, and assets needed to deliver Amazon's and other shippers' volumes at the lowest cost and with the best customer delivery experience. Last Mile Science team owns the core decision models in the space of jurisdiction planning, delivery channel and modes network design, capacity planning for on the road and at delivery stations, routing inputs estimation and optimization. Our research has direct impact on customer experience, driver and station associate experience, Delivery Service Partner (DSP)’s success and the sustainable growth of Amazon. Optimizing the last mile delivery requires deep understanding of transportation, supply chain management, pricing strategies and forecasting. Only through innovative and strategic thinking, we will make the right capital investments in technology, assets and infrastructures that allows for long-term success. Our team members have an opportunity to be on the forefront of supply chain thought leadership by working on some of the most difficult problems in the industry with some of the best product managers, scientists, and software engineers in the industry.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Candidates will be responsible for developing solutions to better manage and optimize delivery capacity in the last mile network. The successful candidate should have solid research experience in one or more technical areas of Operations Research or Machine Learning. These positions will focus on identifying and analyzing opportunities to improve existing algorithms and also on optimizing the system policies across the management of external delivery service providers and internal planning strategies. They require superior logical thinkers who are able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems, turn high-level business requirements into mathematical models, identify the right solution approach, and contribute to the software development for production systems. To support their proposals, candidates should be able to independently mine and analyze data, and be able to use any necessary programming and statistical analysis software to do so. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments, which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, and align research focuses with the Amazon's strategic needs. As a senior scientist, you will also help coach/mentor junior scientists in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: BC Sector O and G-Data Scientist-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST**
**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**
**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level 15+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
We're seeking top talents for our AI engineering team to develop high-quality machine learning models, services, and scalable data processing pipelines. Candidates should have a strong computer science background and be ready to handle end-to-end projects, focusing on engineering.
  
  
As an Applied AI ML Lead within the Digital Intelligence team at JPMorgan, you will collaborate with all lines of business and functions to deliver software solutions. You will experiment, develop, and productionize high-quality machine learning models, services, and platforms to make a significant impact on technology and business. Additionally, you will design and implement highly scalable and reliable data processing pipelines, and perform analysis and insights to promote and optimize business results.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Research, develop, and implement machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems related to personalized financial services in retail and digital banking domains.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and drive innovation in banking products and services.
* Collaborate with product managers, key business stakeholders, engineering, and platform partners to lead challenging projects that deliver cutting-edge machine learning-driven digital solutions.
* Conduct research to develop state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and models tailored to financial applications in personalization and recommendation spaces.
* Design experiments, establish mathematical intuitions, implement algorithms, execute test cases, validate results, and productionize highly performant, scalable, trustworthy, and often explainable solutions.
* Collaborate with data engineers and product analysts to preprocess and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest publications in relevant Machine Learning domains and find applications for the same in your problem spaces for improved outcomes.
* Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders through presentations, reports, and visualizations.
* Work with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure that machine learning models adhere to standards and regulations.
* Mentor Junior Machine Learning associates in delivering successful projects and building successful careers in the firm.
* Participate and contribute back to firm-wide Machine Learning communities through patenting, publications, and speaking engagements.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or Machine learning related field.
* Expert in at least one of the following areas: Natural Language Processing, Knowledge Graph, Computer Vision, Speech Recognition, Reinforcement Learning, Ranking and Recommendation, or Time Series Analysis.
* Deep knowledge in Data structures, Algorithms, Machine Learning, Data Mining, Information Retrieval, Statistics.
* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning frameworks: Tensorflow, Pytorch, pyG, Keras, MXNet, Scikit-Learn.
* Strong programming knowledge of python, spark; Strong grasp on vector operations using numpy, scipy.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills for problem solving.
* Excellent written and oral communication along with demonstrated teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience in working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and stakeholders.
* A strong desire to stay updated with the latest advancements in the field and continuously improve one's skills

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 8+ (MS) or 5+ (PhD) years of relevant experience.
* Deep hands-on experience with real-world ML projects, either through academic research, internships, or industry roles.
* Experience with distributed data/feature engineering using popular cloud services like AWS EMR
* Experience with large scale training, validation and testing experiments.
* Experience with cloud Machine Learning services in AWS like Sagemaker and Container technology like Docker, ECS etc.
* Experience with Kubernetes based platform for Training or Inferencing.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Fraud Operations
description:
Navan is expanding its Fraud Risk Management team to build world-class fraud detection, prevention, and analytics capabilities supporting our rapidly growing travel and expense businesses. We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary
**Data Scientist, Fraud,**
to design and scale advanced data science solutions that protect Navan’s customers, platform, and financial ecosystem.
  
  
This is a strategic and hands-on role, where you’ll partner with other fraud strategy members, product, engineering, and data teams to design the ML features, build the rule workflow, build next-generation fraud models, develop actionable insights, and lead the application of AI/ML to mitigate emerging fraud threats both in expense card issuing and travel fraud. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in machine learning and data systems with a strong understanding of payment, identity, and transactional fraud patterns.
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the design and deployment of advanced ML features, build rule workflows to detect and prevent fraud across travel and expense.
* Lead the design and development of advanced ML and statistical models to detect, predict, and prevent fraudulent behavior across onboarding, payments, and expense workflows.
* Drive applied research in anomaly detection, network/graph modelling, real-time clustering, and link analysis to identify emerging fraud patterns and organized fraud rings.
* Partner cross-functionally with other Risk Strategy team members, Fraud operations, Engineering, and Product teams to translate insights into scalable prevention rules, thresholds, and model-driven interventions.
* Own model lifecycle management from feature engineering and experimentation to monitoring, model retraining, and post-deployment optimisation.
* Perform root-cause and loss attribution analyses, identifying vulnerabilities and quantifying financial impact to inform control effectiveness and business risk appetite.
* Sign up for the stretch fraud loss goals and the ability to drive the roadmap to meet the goal.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering and Platform teams to define data schemas, pipelines, and infrastructure that enable real-time fraud monitoring and analytics.
* Mentor junior data scientists and fraud analysts, providing technical guidance and driving excellence in experimentation, model governance, and reproducibility.
* Contribute to the overall fraud strategy roadmap, helping evolve Navan’s machine learning and analytics capabilities to stay ahead of emerging fraud trends.
* Partner with external vendors and third-party data sources to enrich detection signals and improve model precision and recall.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in data science strategy, with a strong focus on fraud detection, risk modeling, or financial crime analytics.
* Master’s (must-have) or PhD (preferred) in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field.
* Deep technical expertise in machine learning, predictive modelling, anomaly detection, and network analysis applied to fraud problems.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern ML libraries.
* Experience with large-scale data environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, or equivalent big data platforms.
* Strong understanding of payment processing, card networks, identity verification, and behavioural fraud typologies (e.g., synthetic identities, ATO, friendly fraud, first-party fraud, third-party fraud, scams). Demonstrated success in developing and deploying ML models in production, including monitoring and score drift management.
* Familiarity with fraud detection tools, rule engines, and streaming data systems is a plus.
* Proven ability to communicate complex data science findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
* Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams that include Product, Engineering, and Fraud Operations.

description:

The platform combines corporate cards, expense management, cross-border payments, accounting automation, treasury, business banking\*, and more, with AI doing the work finance teams used to do by hand: coding transactions, chasing approvals and receipts, flagging policy breaches, placing treasury deposits, and closing the books.

Alaan has been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 list, UAE Future 100 list, selected as an Endeavor company, and ranked the No. 1 spend management platform in EMEA by G2.

**About the role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Fraud & Risk Data Analyst to join our Risk & Compliance team. * Monitor, analyze, and investigate unusual patterns in customer and transaction data to identify potential fraudulent activity.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and models to track fraud trends, risk exposure, and KPIs.
* Work closely with risk, compliance, and product teams to strengthen fraud detection rules, scoring models, and prevention strategies.

* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing fraud detection tools, rules, and machine learning models; propose refinements for better accuracy.
* Partner with data engineering and product teams to ensure data quality and build scalable fraud monitoring solutions.
* Stay informed about evolving fraud techniques, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices to help future-proof the company’s fraud prevention capabilities.

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Finance, or related field. An advanced degree is a plus.
* 2–4 years of experience in fraud analytics, risk management, or related data-focused roles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Metabase).
* Experience with Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling is preferred.
* Knowledge of fraud detection systems, scoring models, or transaction monitoring frameworks.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear, actionable strategies.
* Excellent communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

**What's in it for you**

* Contribute to building the Middle East’s most beloved fintech brand from the ground up
* Benefit from a role with significant ownership and accountability
* Thrive in a flexible hybrid culture with ample work-life balance
* Participate in exciting offsite events
* Competitive salary and equity
* Enjoy additional perks like travel allowances, gym memberships, and more

* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
* Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
* 4+ years of applied research experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience in applied research

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
**Job Requirements**
**Lead Research Engineer – Data Sciences - Clinical/Lifesciences**
**Introduction**
Siemens Healthineers develops innovations that support better patient outcomes with greater efficiencies, giving providers the confidence they need to meet the clinical, operational and financial challenges of a changing healthcare landscape. With 45,000 employees Siemens Healthineers is one of the world’s largest suppliers of technology to the healthcare industry. As a global leader in medical imaging, laboratory diagnostics, and healthcare information technology, we have a keen understanding of the entire patient care continuum—from prevention and early detection to diagnosis and treatment.
  
  
We would like to recruit candidate who has a keen interest and passion for inter-disciplinary research and development in data sciences and diagnostics. This person will be involved in hands-on analysis of clinical data and development of computational algorithms.
  
  
**What are my responsibilities?**

* Drive research at the intersection of clinical data and AI/ML to solve complex problems in healthcare and diagnostics.
* Analyze and model multimodal clinical and diagnostic data using statistical, machine learning and AI approaches to derive clinically meaningful insights and decision-support solutions.
* Design, develop and evaluate AI/ML algorithms with a strong focus on methodological rigor, robustness, generalizability and clinical relevance.
* Develop reproducible research pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation and performance assessment using Python, R or other appropriate programming languages.
* Contribute to scientific innovation through patents, publications in high-impact journals and conferences, technical reports and other forms of intellectual property.
* Mentor junior researchers and data scientists, promote scientific rigor and reproducibility, and contribute to building a strong research culture within the team.
* Communicate complex technical and scientific concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**What do I need to qualify for this job?**

* Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering or a related quantitative discipline. Masters with 3-5 years of experience or PhDs with 0-2 years of experience, having some experience in the clinical, health or disease diagnostics focus.
* Strong research orientation and scientific curiosity, with demonstrated ability to formulate research questions, develop hypotheses, investigate novel approaches and independently drive research projects.
* Strong theoretical and practical foundation in statistics, machine learning and data science, including appropriate understanding of model development, validation, uncertainty and statistical inference.
* Hands-on experience working with real-world clinical, biomedical or healthcare data, preferably involving longitudinal, multimodal, high-dimensional or observational datasets.
* Proficiency in Python and/or R, with the ability to build robust and reproducible data analysis and machine learning pipelines.
* Experience with modern machine learning and deep learning methodologies and relevant frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn or equivalent tools.
* Experience with clinical prediction, risk stratification, decision support, medical AI or healthcare analytics is highly desirable.
* Understanding of experimental design, clinical study methodology and evaluation of AI/ML models in healthcare is a strong advantage.
* Experience with cloud-based data and ML environments such as Azure, AWS or equivalent platforms is a plus.
* Strong scientific communication skills, with demonstrated ability to contribute to peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, patents or other research outputs.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.
* A strong interest in turning scientific research into impactful healthcare solutions is essential.

*In case you have acquired your skills in alternative ways your application is just as well appreciated.*
**What else do I need to know?**
Siemens is dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please ensure you complete all areas of the application form to the best of your ability as we will use the data to review your suitability for the role.

title: Sr Analyst Performance & Insights
description:
**Pyramid Overview**
Roundel is Target’s retail media network. Roundel designs and delivers impactful marketing for brands and their agencies, resulting in engagement and incremental sales that can be measured online and in-store, all within premium, brand-safe environments.
  
  
**About The Job**
The Performance & Insights team enables advertisers to measure, understand, and optimize the business impact of their media investments through advanced analytics, measurement strategy, experimentation, visualization, data-driven storytelling, and emerging AI-enabled analytical capabilities.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst, Performance & Insights, you will lead scaled and custom analytics initiatives that improve advertiser outcomes and advance Roundel's analytical capabilities. You will translate complex business questions into structured analytical approaches, apply advanced statistical and measurement techniques, and develop actionable recommendations that support better media and investment decisions.
  
  
A key focus of this role will be turning recurring analytical questions into repeatable capabilities through reusable frameworks, automated analyses, dashboards, statistical models, and modular solutions adopted across advertisers, categories, campaigns, and Performance & Insights teams. You will strengthen statistical rigor by applying established statistical tests, experimental designs, regression models, and time-series methods; validating findings; and establishing clear, defensible criteria for interpreting results.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, hands-on applied statistical and causal measurement expertise, digital media measurement knowledge, technical proficiency, visualization and storytelling skills, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to work across business, analytics, and technology teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Measurement strategy & expertise: Translate business questions into practical analytical and measurement approaches, choosing suitable methods and explaining assumptions, bias and limitations.
* Statistical rigor & evidence validation: Apply statistical tests, confidence intervals, power and sample-size calculations to assess performance differences and determine whether results are meaningful.
* Develop predictive and diagnostic analytical capabilities: Use regression, time-series and predictive analysis to understand performance drivers, conversion behavior, seasonality and potential growth or investment opportunities
* Lead and deliver custom analytics projects for the P&I team: Deliver custom analyses of campaign, audience, creative and customer performance, for existing and emerging business questions
* Productize repeatable analytical work: Convert recurring analyses and business questions into reusable modules, frameworks, datasets, metrics, code packages, dashboards, and self-service products with clear inputs, quality checks, statistical validation and guidance for interpreting results.
* Analytical storytelling & decision support: Present clear recommendations, work with business, measurement, product and data teams, and help analysts adopt new methods and tools.
* Partner cross-functionally: Work with Product, Measurement, Data Strategy, GTM, and P&I teams to align analytical capabilities with business needs.
* Responsible GenAI usage: Explore responsible uses of GenAI to simplify analytical workflows, automate routine work and support insight generation while maintaining appropriate validation and oversight.

**About You**

* 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, retail analytics, measurement, data science, or a related analytical discipline.
* Master's degree in Statistics or Economics, Data Science, Analytics or a related quantitative field.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of descriptive statistics; hypothesis testing (t-tests and z-tests); confidence intervals; Pearson and Spearman correlation; proportion and chi-square tests; and the ability to interpret meaningful performance differences and uncertainty.
* Practical experience with A/B testing and experimental design, including test/control groups, randomization, statistical power, and sample-size calculations. Ability to assess bias, assumptions, and limitations and explain whether results support a business conclusion.
* Ability to apply linear, multiple linear and logistic regression, time-series analysis, and outlier detection or robust statistics to business problems.
* Advanced SQL and working proficiency in Python for statistical analysis and reusable workflows; experience with relevant libraries such as pandas, NumPy, SciPy or statsmodels and cloud platforms such as GCP or Azure.
* Good to have: ANOVA, bootstrap methods, multiple-comparison corrections, matched controls, difference-in-differences, segmentation/clustering, response models or other advanced predictive and causal techniques.
* Hands-on familiarity with Generative AI and large language model applications in analytical workflows, including areas such as prompt design, code assistance, analytical agents/workflows, governed knowledge retrieval, and automated synthesis.
* Experience building analytical solutions and communicating findings clearly, with working knowledge of BI tools and practical GenAI applications.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Principal Scientist
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**About the AI Technology Innovation Centre**

We are establishing a world class AI research center called “AI Technology Innovation Center” (TIC) in Bengaluru. The TIC will drive research in frontier AI technology with top AI talent and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The research breakthrough will lead to commercialization of next generation AI solutions. The AI TIC is being strategically designed to establish a globally recognized leader in AI research and development, driving innovation and setting industry benchmarks. The TIC aims to attract, nurture, and retain top-tier AI talent in India by fostering a dynamic, inclusive, and high-impact work environment that encourages continuous learning and breakthrough thinking.

By seamlessly integrating commercial agility with a pioneering scientific mindset, we will deliver scalable AI solutions that address real-world challenges while pushing the frontiers of technology. This ensures that our AI-TIC excels in cutting-edge research and translates discoveries into tangible business value, reinforcing our position as a hub for AI excellence.

**The Role Mandate**

We are seeking a
**Principal Scientist**
– Generative AI & NLP to lead our research and development efforts in cutting-edge AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), multimodal AI, and agentic systems. This role is ideal for a seasoned AI researcher and technologist with a strong publication record, deep algorithmic expertise, and hands-on experience in building and optimizing large-scale AI systems under real-world constraints. You will play a pivotal role in setting the research direction, leading high-impact publications, and driving the development of scalable, production-ready AI solutions that power next-generation products. The research direction is to achieve AI and Agentic system with emotional empathy, self-learning capability, multimodal memory for on-premise product deployment.

͏

**Why This Role - What You Gain**

* **Frontier problems**

Work on largely unclaimed research questions spanning emotion, memory, learning and action

* **Publication as a core outcome**

Pursue top-tier papers and patents with the time, data and technical environment to do so.

* **Research that ships**

See algorithms become globally relevant products and learn from real-world use.

* **Scientific leadership**

Shape methodology, mentor scientists and set the Centre-wide research standard.

**The Larger Impact**

* Define novel algorithms and model families for the TIC signature research themes.
* Build evaluation science for empathy, memory, reasoning, tool use, safety and efficiency.
* Create publications, patents, datasets, benchmarks and reusable research assets.
* Translate advances into prototypes and production-readiness evidence with engineering leaders.
* Position Bengaluru as a source of original AI science and not only downstream engineering.

͏

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Research Leadership**
  + Define and drive the research roadmap in
    **LLMs**
    ,
    **multimodal AI**
    , and
    **Generative AI**
    .
  + Lead the authoring and publication of
    **top-tier research papers**
    (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR).
  + Stay at the forefront of AI advancements and translate research into practical, scalable solutions.
* **Algorithm & System Design**

+ Design and optimize
  **novel algorithms**
  for generative modeling, NLP, and agentic AI under system and compute constraints.
+ Lead the development of
  **high-performance training pipelines**
  for large-scale models, including distributed training and inference optimization.

* **Product & Platform Development**

+ Architect and implement
  **end-to-end GenAI systems**
  , including
  **prompt orchestration**
  ,
  **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)**
  , and
  **agentic workflows**
  .
+ Collaborate with engineering, product, and data science teams to integrate AI solutions into production environments.
+ Build and maintain
  **highly scalable backend microservices**
  and
  **real-time inference systems**
  on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

* **Mentorship & Collaboration**

+ Mentor junior scientists / engineers in
  **GenAI best practices**
  and
  **research methodologies**
  .
+ Work cross-functionally to align AI initiatives with business goals and customer needs.

**How the Centre Works**

The TIC follows a research-to-product operating model. Scientists and engineers work as one team across hypothesis formation, algorithm design, model development, evaluation, platform engineering and technology transfer. Every role combines technical depth with ownership, reproducibility, responsible AI and clear communication of outcomes.

͏

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Experience and leadership**

* Ph.D. or master’s in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
* 10–15 years of industry and/or academic experience in AI/ML, with 7+ years in NLP and Generative AI.
* Demonstrated leadership in publishing top-tier research in LLMs, multimodal models, or related areas.
* Proven experience in large-scale model training, optimization, and deployment.
* Expertise in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, JAX.
* Deep understanding of LLMs, multimodal AI, embedding models, vector databases, and agentic AI.
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC, SageMaker, Vertex AI).
* Strong system design skills, including distributed systems, data pipelines, and API development.

**What Success Looks Like (18-24 Months)**

* A focused research portfolio and roadmap for on-premise AGI and Agentic System
* Publications in top-tier AI conferences and patents portfolio
* Leading strong research team to achieve the on-premise AGI objective
* Novel algorithms and methods that outperform existing benchmarks and having reproducible results
* Research oriented towards product commercialization

͏

Experience: >10 YEARS .

title: AI & ML
description:
**GEMBA CONCEPTS**
Experience: ~3–5 years Type: Full-time
  
  
AI/ML Engineer
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**About Gemba Concepts**
Gemba Concepts is a lean manufacturing and technology consulting firm helping clients across pharma, manufacturing, and logistics
  
  
modernize how they operate. We build production systems that sit close to the shop floor — warehouse management, manufacturing
  
  
traceability, and an applied AI/ML platform whose flagship use cases are visual quality inspection and predictive maintenance. We’re a
  
  
tight engineering team that ships real systems for demanding, often regulated, environments.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for an AI/ML Engineer to take ML capabilities from prototype to production. You’ll own models end-to-end — framing the
  
  
problem with stakeholders, building and validating the model, and deploying it as a reliable service that holds up against real-world, messy
  
  
industrial data. This is a hands-on building role, not a pure research seat: your work goes into client-facing systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Build and ship computer vision models for visual quality inspection (defect detection, classification, segmentation) that perform under
  
  
real factory lighting, throughput, and edge-case conditions.
  
  
Develop predictive maintenance models using sensor/time-series data — anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life estimation, failure
  
  
prediction.
  
  
Own the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, training, evaluation, and deployment, with proper versioning and monitoring.
  
  
Deploy and serve models in production on Azure (AKS), and keep them healthy — track drift, retraining triggers, and latency.
  
  
Integrate LLM-based capabilities (we use the Claude API and self-hosted open models) into delivery and product workflows where they
  
  
add leverage.
  
  
Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain experts to translate fuzzy operational problems into well-scoped ML solutions — and to
  
  
know when ML is not the right answer.
  
  
Communicate results and limitations clearly to non-ML stakeholders, including clients.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
3–5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production (not just notebooks or coursework).
  
  
Strong Python and the modern ML stack — PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NumPy/Pandas.
  
  
Solid grounding in at least one of: computer vision (CNNs, object detection/segmentation, image preprocessing) or time-series /
  
  
anomaly detection.
  
  
Practical MLOps experience: containerization (Docker), model serving, experiment tracking, and deploying on a cloud platform — Azure /
  
  
Kubernetes (AKS) is a strong plus.
  
  
Comfort working with imperfect, real-world data — labeling strategy, class imbalance, data drift, and validation that reflects production
  
  
reality.
  
  
Good engineering hygiene (Git, testing, code review) and the ability to write code others can build on.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with industrial / manufacturing data or regulated environments (pharma, 21 CFR Part 11 awareness).
  
  
Hands-on LLM integration experience — RAG, prompt engineering, working with APIs or self-hosted models (vLLM, Qwen, etc.).
  
  
Edge deployment experience (running CV models on-device / near the line).
  
  
Exposure to data pipeline tooling and orchestration.
  
  
**What You’ll Get**
Real ownership of ML systems that go into production for serious clients.
  
  
A lean, senior-heavy team where you ship fast and learn across the stack.
  
  
Direct exposure to applied AI in manufacturing — a domain where the work has tangible, physical impact
  
  
Skills:- Machine Learning (ML), Python, PyTorch, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Object Detection, Image segmentation, Time series, Anomaly Detection, Predictive Maintenance, MLOps, Kubernetes, Azure OpenAI, MLFlow, Large Language Models (LLM) tuning and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)

title: Senior Operations Research Engineer
description:
**Senior AI/ML Scientist(IC) (Operations Research/Optimization)**
**A.P. Moller - Maersk**
A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.
  
  
Today, we have more than 180 nationalities represented in our workforce across 131 Countries and this mean, we have elevated level of responsibility to continue to build inclusive workforce that is truly representative of our customers and their customers and our vendor partners too.
  
  
The team - who are we:
  
  
We are an ambitious team with the shared passion to use data, data science (DS), machine learning (ML),
  
  
advanced simulation, optimization and engineering excellence to make a difference for our customers.
  
  
We are a team, not a collection of individuals. We value our diverse backgrounds, our different personalities and
  
  
strengths & weaknesses. We value trust and passionate debates. We challenge each other and hold each other
  
  
accountable. We uphold a caring feedback culture to help each other grow, professionally and personally.
  
  
We are now seeking a new team member who is excited about developing advanced optimization algorithms, simulation models and AI/ML solutions that create operational insights for container shipping terminals
  
  
worldwide, helping them optimize container handling, yard operations, vessel operations, and drive efficiency
  
  
and business value.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You will be part of the APM Terminals technical team. As a Senior Operations Research Engineer, you will have a leading role in designing, building, maintaining, and iterating on products that directly impact terminal operations.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to develop and apply your deep knowledge of operations research methods to create operational and strategic insights that are transforming container terminal operations globally.
  
  
This is an exciting time to join a growing and dynamic team that solves some of the toughest problems in
  
  
terminal operations and builds the future of container shipping. We offer a unique opportunity to impact global
  
  
trade via world-leading container terminals. We focus on our people and the right candidate will have broad
  
  
possibilities to further develop competencies in an environment characterized by change and continuous
  
  
progress.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the design, implementation and delivery of advanced optimization solutions for terminal operations including container handling equipment efficiency, yard positioning strategies, vessel loading/unloading sequencing, and truck routing.
* Build both operational tools for day-to-day terminal operations and strategic models for long-term planning and decision-making.
* Coach and mentor junior team members in optimization techniques and operations research methodologies.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to understand terminal operational dynamics and business processes, incorporating their needs into products to enhance value delivery.
* Collaborate and communicate model rationale, results and insights with product teams, leadership and business stakeholders to roll out solutions to production environments.
* Analyse data, measure delivered value, and continuously evaluate and improve models to increase effectiveness and operational impact.
* Validate and iterate on optimization solutions against discrete event simulation models of terminal operations,
* System design, architecture, and solution design for new features.

What you bring:
  
  

* 5+ years of industry experience in building and delivering optimization solutions
* PhD or M.Sc. in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or other field related to algorithms and data (or equivalent experience).
* Depth in optimization modelling — LP, MILP, constraint programming, and/or metaheuristics, applied to problems like scheduling, sequencing, routing, bin packing, and resource allocation.
* Fluency implementing these in Python across open-source and commercial solvers (e.g. PuLP, OR-Tools/CP-SAT, HiGHS, Gurobi).
* Experience developing optimization models for stochastic operational environments, and evaluating them against simulation.
* Track record of delivering production-quality Python.
* Ability to understand complex operational systems and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Experience in leading technical work, coaching junior colleagues, and driving projects from concept to delivery.

A strong plus:
  
  

* Experience in container terminal operations, port logistics, or similar operational environments with complex resource allocation and scheduling dynamics.
* Familiarity with container handling equipment, yard operations, or vessel operations. Experience in material handling, manufacturing operations, or other domains involving physical asset optimization and sequencing problems.
* Discrete Event Simulation, AI/ML methods for operational problems, Prescriptive analytics (e.g., stochastic optimization, reinforcement learning).
* Experience developing and interacting with generative AI models.

title: Senior Manager - Model Controls Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
**– Senior Manager - Model Controls Engineer**
Join a team focused on strengthening the quality, reliability, and governance of analytical models and data-driven decisioning. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in model testing, data validation, and analytics to help ensure the integrity of critical financial crimes detection capabilities.
  
  
**The Purpose of This Role**
The Model Assurance Testing and Controls team is responsible for independently validating analytical models, testing model outputs, and strengthening controls that support Fidelity's Financial Crimes Compliance programs. As a Senior Manager, Model Controls Engineer, you will work closely with data scientists, engineers, compliance partners, and risk stakeholders to ensure model outputs are accurate, explainable, and consistently performing as expected. Your work will help strengthen governance, improve data quality, and support regulatory and audit readiness across the organization.
  
  
**The Value You Deliver**

* Executing independent model testing by running replicated model workflows and comparing results against production outputs
* Investigating, documenting, and validating discrepancies between production and test environments
* Evaluating model behavior and outputs to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment with expected outcomes
* Analyzing large datasets to identify data quality issues, anomalies, and potential data drift
* Developing and enhancing automated testing, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities
* Supporting audit and regulatory activities through transparent, traceable, and well-documented validation processes

**The Skills That Are Key To This Role**
**Technical / Behavioral**

* You have strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, analysis, reconciliation, and validation
* You have strong Python programming skills for analytics, automation, testing, and data quality assessments
* You are experienced in reviewing and evaluating code to understand model logic and data transformations
* You can work effectively with large and complex datasets while maintaining attention to detail
* You bring a structured approach to documentation, testing, and governance activities
* You demonstrate the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams to solve complex problems

**The Skills that are Good To Have for this role**

* You have experience with model validation, model risk management, or controls frameworks
* You understand data governance, data quality management, and monitoring best practices
* You have familiarity with financial crimes compliance, fraud detection, AML, or related analytical domains
* You have experience identifying and assessing data drift and model performance concerns
* You are comfortable supporting audit, risk, and regulatory review processes
* You can effectively prioritize multiple initiatives in a dynamic environment

**How Your Work Impacts The Organization**
The Financial Crimes Detections & Analytics team within Fidelity's Enterprise Compliance organization is dedicated to protecting Fidelity and its clients from financial crimes. The team develops and enhances advanced analytics and machine learning models used to detect suspicious activity and support compliance obligations. By ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of these models, you help strengthen regulatory compliance, improve risk management practices, and increase confidence in critical business decisions. Your contributions directly support the effectiveness and integrity of Fidelity's financial crimes detection capabilities.
  
  
**The Expertise We’re Looking For**

* 7+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Data Engineering, Model Validation, Model Risk Management, Controls Engineering, or a related field
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* Strong experience with SQL and Python in analytical and testing environments
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and performing data analysis, variance analysis, and reconciliation
* Demonstrated experience in model testing, controls, validation, or governance activities
* Experience supporting compliance, risk, audit, or regulatory initiatives is a plus

**Company Overview**
At Fidelity, we are focused on making our financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want. We are a privately held company that places a high degree of value in creating and nurturing a work environment that attracts the best talent and reflects our commitment to our associates. We are proud of our diverse and inclusive workplace where we respect and value our associates for their unique perspectives and experiences. Fidelity India has been the Global Inhouse Center of Fidelity Investments since 2003 with offices in Bangalore and Chennai. For information about working at Fidelity, visit India.Fidelity.com.

title: Manager - AI GTM and Market Intelligence
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Most GTM teams wait for demand to declare itself. This role builds the systems that find it first. As Manager — AI GTM and Market Intelligence, you will own the engine that identifies high-fit D2C merchants before they raise a hand, the internal tools Marketing and Sales rely on daily to see what our spend is actually producing, and the proprietary data stories that establish GoKwik’s authority in the market. This is a builder’s role rather than an analyst’s: the output is working software and published research other teams depend on, not reports. You will use AI as your primary build leverage, partner closely with Demand Generation, Sales, Brand and PR, and own each system end to end — from the idea to the thing running in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* AI Outbound & Signal Pipeline - Own GoKwik’s outbound motion end to end: build the ICP from proprietary merchant data and third-party market sources, detect intent signals such as checkout migrations, funding rounds and founder activity, and convert them into AI-personalised outreach that reaches high-fit D2C brands before they enter the market.
* Marketing Intelligence Platform - Own the internal tools Marketing, Sales and CS run on: the funnel from lead to go-live, ad spend joined to closed deals for true cost-per-outcome, competitive share of voice, and self-serve AI reporting that removes the dependency on manual data pulls. Each tool ships with a user guide and must be actively used by the team it was built for.
* Data-Led Thought Leadership - Turn GoKwik’s proprietary transaction data into publishable industry research no competitor can replicate. Own the data and the narrative from first principles to final draft, in partnership with Brand and PR.
* Attribution & Funnel Integrity - Own how marketing performance is measured: canonical definitions for lead, MQL, SQL and go-live, campaign taxonomy and UTM governance, and distinct attribution for outbound and signal-sourced pipeline in Salesforce. Hold these definitions steady across Marketing, Sales and Finance when numbers are contested.
* Automation & Reliability - Run these systems as production software, not side projects. Own the scheduled jobs, monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy, and design alerts that stay quiet until something genuinely needs attention.
* Enablement & Documentation - Build for handover from day one. Every tool, dashboard and automated workflow carries written documentation, a named owner and a walkthrough session, so no system depends on one person’s context to keep running.

**Who You Are**

* 4–6 years of experience across growth, demand generation, marketing analytics, revenue operations or product, with a track record of building tools rather than only reporting on them.
* Demonstrable experience building working internal tools, automations or data products using AI as the primary build leverage. You should be able to walk us through something you shipped that other people depended on, and what broke along the way.
* Strong SQL and comfort interrogating a number to its source before it is acted on. Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and with a data warehouse.
* Commercial fluency in D2C, eCommerce, payments or B2B SaaS go-to-market. You understand what a lead, an MQL and a go-live mean, and why the definitions get argued about.
* Proven experience running outbound or lifecycle campaigns, including prospect research, segmentation, sequencing and reply handling.
* Excellent written communication. A large part of this role is explaining a number to a senior stakeholder who will act on it, and writing research that stands up to external scrutiny.
* Comfortable owning systems in production: when a scheduled job fails, you investigate rather than escalate.
* Hands-on experience with ad platforms and campaign measurement across Google, Meta or emerging AI ad surfaces is a strong plus.
* A computer science degree or a background as a software engineer is not required. What matters is the judgment to know what is worth building and the ability to direct AI tooling to build it correctly.

**Why GoKwik**
At GoKwik, you work at the intersection of go-to-market, product and data. This role sits on a foundation that already exists: a live platform of internal GTM products, an outbound engine with a scored universe of more than 16,000 D2C brands, and first-party transaction data across 15,000+ merchants that no competitor can replicate. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are not inheriting a backlog of requests — you are taking custody of systems people already use and deciding where they go next.
  
  
You get unusual autonomy and unusually direct exposure: the freedom to choose what gets built, a short line to senior stakeholders, and work that is visible externally through published research as well as internally through the tools leadership reviews. For someone who wants to build rather than brief, in a performance-driven team with real ownership from week one, there are few roles in Indian eCommerce with this much surface area.
  
  
**Required Skills**
AI stakeholder management Problem-solving marketing automation analytics Business growth

title: Senior Manager-AI Innovation & Research
description:
**Job Description**
AI Labs seeks a Senior AI Researcher (Senior Manager) to lead a team of Ai researchers that will powers credit, fraud and marketing decisions. The candidate serves as a thought leader and a problem-solver who can blend business, technical, and industry best practices when it comes to developing the models, and algorithms that power our customers’ digital experiences. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI research, large-scale AI platforms, and large-scale compute infrastructure. The Sr. Manager will help define and execute a forward-looking research agenda and help to translate cutting-edge machine learning, and systems innovation into scalable, governed, and business-critical AI capabilities. Role is focused on creation and integration of foundational models that can provide value for multiple modelling usecases.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep hand-on ML research expertise with strong practical knowledge and experience in building scalable infrastructure and data science platforms.
  
  
Colleagues in AI Labs serve as key members of the Global Decision Science organization within Credit and Fraud Risk at American Express. This critical team is responsible for managing enterprise risks throughout the customer lifecycle, across our consumer and commercial businesses, and across all our global products. We develop industry-first data capabilities, build profitable decision-making frameworks, create machine learning-powered predictive models, and improve customer servicing strategies.
  
  
Our Global Decision Science teams use industry leading modelling and AI practices to predict customer behaviour. We develop, deploy and validate predictive models and support the use of models in economic logic to enable profitable decisions across credit, fraud, marketing and servicing optimization engines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and drive implementation of advanced AI research and integration into business in areas such as foundation models, graph-based methods, reinforcement learning, and causal-modelling techniques.
* Lead research and implementation of Tabular Foundational Models (TFMs) for structured data and modelling usecases.
* Lead research, development and implementation of Sequence-based foundational models for event streams, such customer actions and transaction histories.
* Partner with business users, technology and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions are flexible, secure, cost-effective, and compliant with enterprise standards
* Translate research outcomes into production-ready platforms, tools, and capabilities that are adopted at scale across the enterprise
* Provide thought leadership for research in Ai research and machine learning. Present and communicate research findings to senior leadership, influencing enterprise-level decision-making and strategic direction.
* Work in close partnership with other research teams in AI labs.
* Lead a team of Ai researchers and create a highly effective and engaged team culture focused on innovation.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent work experience. 4+ years of work experience in applied research lab organisations is required.
* Very strong record of applied research impact through platforms, patents, production systems, or enterprise-scale adoption, in addition to traditional publications.
* Expertise with GPU-accelerated ML workloads, high-performance computing, and advanced optimization techniques are essential.
* Expert knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling methods for supervised and unsupervised learning in areas such as transformer and attention-based architectures, deep learning for structured sequential and graph data, multi-task and transfer learning.
* Exceptional programming skills in Python, Spark. Additional knowledge of C/C++ and Java is preferred
* Expertise in hybrid-cloud AI/ML infrastructure, including Google Cloud (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataproc) and large-scale distributed computing environments.
* Strong knowledge of databases and related languages/tools such as SQL, NoSQL, Hive, etc.
* Exceptional people leadership and managerial skills
* Ability to work in a dynamic, cross-functional environment, with a strong attention to detail
* Effective communication skills and ability to explain complex data products in simple terms
* Strong relationship building and collaborative skills.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

title: Credit Risk Senior Analyst - CECL Reporting, Loss Forecasting
description:
**Credit Risk Senior Analyst**
We are a rapidly growing company that’s revolutionizing the way the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.
  
  
The Fintech Risk team at Toast is responsible for driving risk informed growth for the rapidly expanding Toast Fintech line of business. We are seeking a Lead Credit Risk Strategist as part of the team, with a focus on the portfolio risk management space. You will partner with cross-functional analysts and senior leadership to decode complex portfolio risk trends, refine our loss forecasting models, develop and oversee line management strategies for credit cards and other revolving products, and build the early-warning defenses that allow us to stay resilient under stress and profitable in any market cycle. If you have an analytic and data driven mindset, eye for detail and can-do attitude then you are right for this position.
  
  
**Responsibilities :**

* CECL Reporting: Oversee the monthly CECL calculations and reporting process, collaborating closely with accounting and strategic finance teams to ensure the robustness of methodology and accuracy of loss reserve calculations.
* Loss Forecasting: Refine existing loss forecasting models / methodologies which feed into monthly CECL calculations, to improve the overall accuracy and stability of forecasts. Develop loss projection and expected loss estimation methodologies for revolving products (e.g. credit card).
* Portfolio Risk Strategy: Define, implement, and continuously improve the portfolio risk management strategy (including collections), ensuring alignment with company appetite.
* Risk Reporting and Monitoring: Develop and maintain a comprehensive and timely reporting framework to provide risk visibility to management, ensuring that risk and return are optimized and in line with company goals. Define and monitor key KPIs
* Emerging Risk Identification and Mitigation: Proactively identify emerging risks and propose data-driven mitigation solutions to minimize potential losses and optimize returns.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with Product Management, Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Accounting, and Strategic Finance teams, driving alignment and facilitating data-driven decision-making.
* Policy Management: Maintain and update CECL methodology documents and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory and audit requirements.

**Data enhancement and enrichment: Work with product and engineering to make sure that right data is in the pipelines for reporting and analytics**
**Requirements :**

* 5+ years of experience in consumer or small business lending in a quantitative risk strategy / analytics role, with hands-on experience in loss forecasting and expected loss estimation.
* Quantitative degree (Mathematics/Statistics/Economics/Operations Research) preferred, Masters Degree or MBA a plus
* Proficiency in SQL and Python/R, with experience in data visualization tools such as Hex/ Tableau/Looker/Sigma
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Proven ability to navigate a cross-functional, non-hierarchical environment, fostering collaboration and driving alignment across teams

Media.net is a leading global ad tech company, building innovative products and solutions for advertisers and publishers. Media.net creates the most transparent and efficient path for ad budgets to become publisher revenue, while delivering meaningful value to advertisers, publishers, app developers, and end users across the open web.

We are one of the world’s largest independent contextual advertising businesses, with one of the industry’s most comprehensive advertising technology portfolios. Media.net powers major publishers and ad-tech platforms across formats, including display, video, mobile, native, search, and local. Our platform manages high-quality ad supply across 500,000+ websites and is licensed by the biggest publishers, ad networks, and technology partners worldwide.

Beyond our core advertising business, Media.net also operates at scale in performance-driven consumer acquisition, app development and distribution, and strategic technology investments. These efforts are supported by one of the world’s largest independent software development engines, enabling us to innovate rapidly and build products used across global markets.

Media.net is home to 1,300+ employees, with key operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our US headquarters is in New York, and our global headquarters is in Dubai. Across 50+ demand partners, 21K+ publishers, and a growing portfolio of products and services, we take great pride in driving trusted, transparent, and scalable results.

**The role**

Our DS/ML teams work on some of the hardest problems in ad tech: predicting what an ad will earn before it’s shown, matching the right ad to a page in milliseconds, and learning from clicks that are rare and noisy. You’ll be the PM who decides which of these bets we take, in what order, and how we know they worked.

You won’t build the models. You’ll work alongside the people who do, and your job is to turn open-ended research into a roadmap that moves revenue.

**What you’ll work on**

* **Revenue and CTR prediction:**
  how do we estimate it across thousands of domains and millions of URLs, by slot, device, location and content?
* **Ad matching:**
  how do we handle cold-start for new ads and pages, and make explore-exploit learn faster?
* **Targeting:**
  how do we combine contextual and behavioral signals well?
* **Identity resolution:**
  how do we build a reliable user identity out of messy signals?
* **NLP:**
  what can we learn from page and ad content that we’re missing today?

**What you’ll do**

* Own the roadmap for one or more of these areas and balance long-shot research against wins we can ship now
* Turn early prototypes into scoped, sequenced initiatives with DS and Engineering
* Decide what success looks like (model quality, revenue, latency, adoption) and build the reporting to track it
* Explain the roadmap to leadership and cross-functional teams, and why it deserves the investment

**You might be a fit if you have**

* 6+ years in product, with real time working alongside DS, ML or research teams
* Shipped something that moved a core metric (revenue, engagement, efficiency) at scale
* Enough ML fluency to follow and challenge a conversation about ranking, bandits or sparse data
* Strong instincts for experimentation, and the ability to tell when an offline win won’t hold up online
* The ability to explain technical trade-offs plainly to non-technical people

**Bonus**

Ad tech, programmatic or auction marketplace experience. Exposure to large-scale data platforms or NLP products.

**Why this role**

Few PM roles let you own a roadmap where the technical problems are this hard and the revenue impact this direct. You’ll work with a team that has a strong research culture, and you’ll have a real say in what it builds next.
